verses.sa:
यां कल्पयन्ति वहतौ वधूमिव विश्वरूपां हस्तकृतां चिकित्सवः ।
सारादेत्वप नुदाम एनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam kalpayanti vahatau vadhumiva vishvarupam hastakritam chikitsavah |
saradetvapa nudama enam ||
verses.en: She whom the adepts {cikitsú) prepare, all-formed, hand-made, like a bride at a wedding—let her go far off; we push her away.

verses.sa:
शीर्षण्वती नस्वती कर्णिणी कृत्याकृता संभृता विश्वरूपा ।
सारादेत्वप नुदाम एनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shirshanvati nasvati karnini krityakrita sambhrita vishvarupa |
saradetvapa nudama enam ||
verses.en: Having a head, having a nose, having ears, put together, all-formed, by the witchcraft-maker—let her go far off; we push her away.

verses.sa:
शूद्रकृता राजकृता स्त्रीकृता ब्रह्मभिः कृता ।
जाया पत्या नुत्तेव कर्तारं बन्ध्वृच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
shudrakrita rajakrita strikrita brahmabhih krita |
jaya patya nutteva kartaram bandhvrichchhatu ||
verses.en: Çūdra-made, king-made, woman-made, made by Brahmans (brahmán), like a wife expelled (nuttá) by her husband, let her go to her maker, as connection.

verses.sa:
अनयाहमोषध्या सर्वाः कृत्या अदूदुषम् ।
यां क्षेत्रे चक्रुर्यां गोषु यां वा ते पुरुषेषु ॥
verses.rom:
anayahamoshadhya sarvah kritya adudusham |
yam kshetre chakruryam goshu yam va te purusheshu ||
verses.en: With this herb have I spoiled all witchcrafts—what one they have made in the field, what in the kine, or what in thy men.

verses.sa:
अघमस्त्वघकृते शपथः शपथीयते ।
प्रत्यक्प्रतिप्रहिण्मो यथा कृत्याकृतं हनत् ॥
verses.rom:
aghamastvaghakrite shapathah shapathiyate |
pratyakpratiprahinmo yatha krityakritam hanat ||
verses.en: Let evil be to the evil-doer, a curse to the curser; backward we send [her] forth back, that she may slay the witchcraft-maker.

verses.sa:
प्रतीचीन आङ्गिरसोऽध्यक्षो नः पुरोहितः ।
प्रतीचीः कृत्या आकृत्यामून् कृत्याकृतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
pratichina angiraso'dhyaksho nah purohitah |
pratichih kritya akrityamun krityakrito jahi ||
verses.en: Opposed [is] the Ān̄girasa, our appointed (puróhita) overseer; do thou, having turned the witchcrafts in the opposite direction, slay yonder witchcraft-makers.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वोवाच परेहीति प्रतिकूलमुदाय्यम् ।
तं कृत्येऽभिनिवर्तस्व मास्मान् इछो अनागसः ॥
verses.rom:
yastvovacha parehiti pratikulamudayyam |
tam kritye'bhinivartasva masman ichho anagasah ||
verses.en: He who said to thee "go forth," against the current, up-stream, him, O witchcraft, do thou return against; seek not us who are innocent.

verses.sa:
यस्ते परूंषि संदधौ रथस्येव र्भुर्धिया ।
तं गच्छ तत्र तेऽयनमज्ञातस्तेऽयं जनः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste parumshi samdadhau rathasyeva rbhurdhiya |
tam gachchha tatra te'yanamajnataste'yam janah ||
verses.en: He who put together thy joints, as an ṛbhú [those] of a chariot with skill (dhī́), unto him go thou; there is thy going; this person is unknown to thee.

verses.sa:
ये त्वा कृत्वालेभिरे विद्वला अभिचारिणः ।
शंभ्विदं कृत्यादूषणं प्रतिवर्त्म पुनःसरं तेन त्वा स्नपयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ye tva kritvalebhire vidvala abhicharinah |
shambhvidam krityadushanam prativartma punahsaram tena tva snapayamasi ||
verses.en: They who, having made, took hold of thee, cunning sorcerers—this is a healthful (çambhú) spoiler of witchcraft, counteracting, reverting; therewith do we bathe thee.

verses.sa:
यद्दुर्भगां प्रस्नपितां मृतवत्सामुपेयिम ।
अपैतु सर्वं मत्पापं द्रविणं मोप तिष्ठतु ॥
verses.rom:
yaddurbhagam prasnapitam mritavatsamupeyima |
apaitu sarvam matpapam dravinam mopa tishthatu ||
verses.en: In that we have come upon the ill-portioned one (fem.), bathed forth, whose young (-vatsá) is dead—let all ill (pāpá) go away from me; let property come unto (upa-sthā) me.

verses.sa:
यत्ते पितृभ्यो ददतो यज्ञे वा नाम जगृहुः ।
संदेश्यात्सर्वस्मात्पापादिमा मुञ्चन्तु त्वौषधीः ॥
verses.rom:
yatte pitribhyo dadato yajne va nama jagrihuh |
samdeshyatsarvasmatpapadima munchantu tvaushadhih ||
verses.en: In that they have taken (grah) the name of thee giving to the Fathers, or at the sacrifice—let these plants free thee from all ill that is designed (? saṁdeçyà).

verses.sa:
देवैनसात्पित्र्यान् नामग्राहात्संदेश्यादभिनिष्कृतात्।
मुञ्चन्तु त्वा वीरुधो वीर्येण ब्रह्मणा ऋग्भिः पयसा ऋषीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
devainasatpitryan namagrahatsamdeshyadabhinishkritat|
munchantu tva virudho viryena brahmana rigbhih payasa rishinam ||
verses.en: From sin against the gods, against the Fathers, from name-taking, that is designed, that is devised against [any one], let the plants free thee by their energy (vīryà), with spell (bráhman), with verses, with milk of the seers.

verses.sa:
यथा वातश्च्यावयति भूम्या रेणुमन्तरिक्षाच्चाभ्रम् ।
एवा मत्सर्वं दुर्भूतं ब्रह्मनुत्तमपायति ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vatashchyavayati bhumya renumantarikshachchabhram |
eva matsarvam durbhutam brahmanuttamapayati ||
verses.en: As the wind sets in motion the dust from the earth and the cloud (abhrá) from the atmosphere, so from me may everything of evil nature go away, pushed by the spell (bráhman).

verses.sa:
अप क्राम नानदती विनद्धा गर्दभीव ।
कर्तॄन् नक्षस्वेतो नुत्ता ब्रह्मणा वीर्यावता ॥
verses.rom:
apa krama nanadati vinaddha gardabhiva |
kartrin nakshasveto nutta brahmana viryavata ||
verses.en: Step away, making much noise, like an unfastened she-ass; attain thy makers, pushed hence by an energetic spell.

verses.sa:
अयं पन्थाः कृत्येति त्वा नयामोऽभिप्रहितां प्रति त्वा प्र हिण्मः ।
तेनाभि याहि भञ्जत्यनस्वतीव वाहिनी विश्वरूपा कुरूतिनी ॥
verses.rom:
ayam panthah krityeti tva nayamo'bhiprahitam prati tva pra hinmah |
tenabhi yahi bhanjatyanasvativa vahini vishvarupa kurutini ||
verses.en: Saying "this is the road, O witchcraft," we conduct thee; thee that wast sent forth against [us] we send forth back again; by that [road] go against [them], breaking, like a draft-cow with a cart, all-formed, wearing a wreath (? kurūṭín).

verses.sa:
पराक्ते ज्योतिरपथं ते अर्वागन्यत्रास्मदयना कृणुष्व ।
परेणेहि नवतिं नाव्या अति दुर्गाः स्रोत्या मा क्षणिष्ठाः परेहि ॥
verses.rom:
parakte jyotirapatham te arvaganyatrasmadayana krinushva |
parenehi navatim navya ati durgah srotya ma kshanishthah parehi ||
verses.en: Offward is light for thee, hitherward is no road for thee; make thy goings elsewhere than [toward] us; go thou by a distant [road] beyond ninety difficult navigable streams; do not wound thyself; go away.

verses.sa:
वात इव वृक्षान् नि मृणीहि पादय मा गामश्वं पुरुषमुच्छिष एषाम् ।
कर्तॄन् निवृत्येतः कृत्येऽप्रजास्त्वाय बोधय ॥
verses.rom:
vata iva vrikshan ni mrinihi padaya ma gamashvam purushamuchchhisha esham |
kartrin nivrityetah kritye'prajastvaya bodhaya ||
verses.en: As the wind the trees, do thou crush (mṛ) down, cause to fall; do not leave of them cow, horse, man; turning back, O witchcraft, from here to thy makers, awaken them unto childlessness.

verses.sa:
यां ते बर्हिषि यां श्मशाने क्षेत्रे कृत्यां वलगं वा निचख्नुः ।
अग्नौ वा त्वा गार्हपत्येऽभिचेरुः पाकं सन्तं धीरतरा अनागसम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te barhishi yam shmashane kshetre krityam valagam va nichakhnuh |
agnau va tva garhapatye'bhicheruh pakam santam dhiratara anagasam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they buried for thee in the barhís, what in the cemetery, [what] witchcraft or secret spell (valagá) in the field, or practised against thee in the householders' fire—they, being wiser, [against thee] who art simple, innocent.

verses.sa:
उपाहृतमनुबुद्धं निखातं वैरं त्सार्यन्वविदाम कर्त्रम् ।
तदेतु यत आभृतं तत्राश्व इव वि वर्ततां हन्तु कृत्याकृतः प्रजाम् ॥
verses.rom:
upahritamanubuddham nikhatam vairam tsaryanvavidama kartram |
tadetu yata abhritam tatrashva iva vi vartatam hantu krityakritah prajam ||
verses.en: We have found out (anu-vid) the hostile sneaking magic (? kártra) that was applied, perceived (? anu-budh), buried: let that go whence it was brought; there let it roll about like a horse; let it slay the progeny of the witchcraft -maker.

verses.sa:
स्वायसा असयः सन्ति नो गृहे विद्मा ते कृत्ये यतिधा परूंषि ।
उत्तिष्ठैव परेहीतोऽज्ञाते किमिहेच्छसि ॥
verses.rom:
svayasa asayah santi no grihe vidma te kritye yatidha parumshi |
uttishthaiva parehito'jnate kimihechchhasi ||
verses.en: There are knives of good metal in our house; we know thy joints, O witchcraft, how many they are; just stand up; go away from here; unknown one, what seekest thou here?

verses.sa:
ग्रीवास्ते कृत्ये पादौ चापि कर्त्स्यामि निर्द्रव ।
इन्द्राग्नी अस्मान् रक्षतां यौ प्रजानां प्रजावती ॥
verses.rom:
grivaste kritye padau chapi kartsyami nirdrava |
indragni asman rakshatam yau prajanam prajavati ||
verses.en: Thy neck-bones (grīvā́), O witchcraft, and thy (two) feet I will cut up; run thou out; let Indra-and-Agni defend us, they who are of progeny rich in progeny.

verses.sa: सोमो राजाधिपा मृडिता च भूतस्य नः पतयो मृडयन्तु ॥
verses.rom: somo rajadhipa mridita cha bhutasya nah patayo mridayantu ||
verses.en: King Soma [is] our over-ruler and favorer (mṛḍitṛ́); let the lords of being favor us.

verses.sa:
भवाशर्वावस्यतां पापकृते कृत्याकृते ।
दुष्कृते विद्युतं देवहेतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhavasharvavasyatam papakrite krityakrite |
dushkrite vidyutam devahetim ||
verses.en: Let Bhava-and-Çarva hurl (as) at the evil-doer, the witchcraft-maker, the ill-doer, the missile of the gods, the lightning.

verses.sa:
यद्येयथ द्विपदी चतुष्पदी कृत्याकृता संभृता विश्वरूपा ।
सेतोऽष्टापदी भूत्वा पुनः परेहि दुछुने ॥
verses.rom:
yadyeyatha dvipadi chatushpadi krityakrita sambhrita vishvarupa |
seto'shtapadi bhutva punah parehi duchhune ||
verses.en: If thou camest [as] biped, as quadruped, put together by the witchcraft-maker, all-formed, do thou, becoming octoped, go away again from here, O misfortune!

verses.sa:
अभ्यक्ताक्ता स्वरंकृता सर्वं भरन्ती दुरितं परेहि ।
जानीहि कृत्ये कर्तारं दुहितेव पितरं स्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhyaktakta svaramkrita sarvam bharanti duritam parehi |
janihi kritye kartaram duhiteva pitaram svam ||
verses.en: Anointed, smeared, well-adorned, bearing all difficulty, go thou away; recognize (jñā), O witchcraft, thy maker, as a daughter her own father.

verses.sa:
परेहि कृत्ये मा तिष्ठो विद्धस्येव पदं नय ।
मृगः स मृगयुस्त्वं न त्वा निकर्तुमर्हति ॥
verses.rom:
parehi kritye ma tishtho viddhasyeva padam naya |
mrigah sa mrigayustvam na tva nikartumarhati ||
verses.en: Go away, O witchcraft; stand not; lead, as it were, the track of one pierced; it is a deer, thou a deer-hunter; it is unable to put thee down.

verses.sa:
उत हन्ति पूर्वासिनं प्रत्यादायापर इष्वा ।
उत पूर्वस्य निघ्नतो नि हन्त्यपरः प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
uta hanti purvasinam pratyadayapara ishva |
uta purvasya nighnato ni hantyaparah prati ||
verses.en: Also the after one (ápara) slays with an arrow, fitting it (?), the one shooting (-āsin) in front; also of the front one, smiting down, the after one smites down in return.

verses.sa:
एतद्धि शृणु मे वचोऽथेहि यत एयथ ।
यस्त्वा चकार तं प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
etaddhi shrinu me vacho'thehi yata eyatha |
yastva chakara tam prati ||
verses.en: Hear thou, verily, these words of mine; then go whence thou camest, to meet him who made thee.

verses.sa:
अनागोहत्या वै भीमा कृत्ये मा नो गामश्वं पुरुषं वधीः ।
यत्रयत्रासि निहिता ततस्त्वोत्थापयामसि पर्णाल्लघीयसी भव ॥
verses.rom:
anagohatya vai bhima kritye ma no gamashvam purusham vadhih |
yatrayatrasi nihita tatastvotthapayamasi parnallaghiyasi bhava ||
verses.en: The slaying of an innocent person is indeed fearful, O witchcraft; slay thou not our cow, horse, man; wheresoever thou art set down, from there we make thee stand up; become thou lighter than a leaf.

verses.sa:
यदि स्थ तमसावृता जालेनभिहिता इव ।
सर्वाः संलुप्येतः कृत्याः पुनः कर्त्रे प्र हिण्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
yadi stha tamasavrita jalenabhihita iva |
sarvah samlupyetah krityah punah kartre pra hinmasi ||
verses.en: If ye are covered (ā-vṛ) with darkness, like those who are girt (abhi-dhā) with a net—having torn up (sam-lup) all witchcrafts from here, we send them forth again to the maker.

verses.sa:
कृत्याकृतो वलगिनोऽभिनिष्कारिणः प्रजाम् ।
मृणीहि कृत्ये मोच्छिषोऽमून् कृत्याकृतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
krityakrito valagino'bhinishkarinah prajam |
mrinihi kritye mochchhisho'mun krityakrito jahi ||
verses.en: The progeny of the witchcraft-maker, of him of secret spells, of him that devises against [others], O witchcraft, do thou kill; do not leave [them alive]; slay yonder witchcraft-makers.

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यो मुच्यते तमसस्परि रात्रिं जहात्युषसश्च केतून् ।
एवाहं सर्वं दुर्भूतं कर्त्रं कृत्याकृता कृतं हस्तीव रजो दुरितं जहामि ॥
verses.rom:
yatha suryo muchyate tamasaspari ratrim jahatyushasashcha ketun |
evaham sarvam durbhutam kartram krityakrita kritam hastiva rajo duritam jahami ||
verses.en: As the sun is freed out of darkness, [and] quits the night and the ensigns of the dawn, so do I quit all evil-natured magic made by the witchcraft-maker, as an elephant the difficult haze (? rájas).

verses.sa:
केन पार्ष्णी आभृते पूरुषस्य केन मांसं संभृतं केन गुल्फौ ।
केनाङ्गुलीः पेशनीः केन खानि केनोच्छ्लङ्खौ मध्यतः कः प्रतिष्ठाम् ॥
verses.rom:
kena parshni abhrite purushasya kena mamsam sambhritam kena gulphau |
kenangulih peshanih kena khani kenochchhlankhau madhyatah kah pratishtham ||
verses.en: By whom were brought the two heels of a man (púruṣa)? by whom was his flesh put together? by whom his two ankle-joints (gulphá)? by whom his cunning (péçana) fingers? by whom his apertures? by whom his (two) uchlakhás in the midst? who [put together] his footing (pratiṣṭhā́)?

verses.sa:
कस्मान् नु गुल्फावधरावकृण्वन्न् अष्ठीवन्तावुत्तरौ पूरुषस्य ।
जङ्घे निर्ऋत्य न्यदधुः क्व स्विज्जानुनोः संधी क उ तच्चिकेत ॥
verses.rom:
kasman nu gulphavadharavakrinvann ashthivantavuttarau purushasya |
janghe nirritya nyadadhuh kva svijjanunoh samdhi ka u tachchiketa ||
verses.en: From what, now, did they make a man's two ankle-joints below, his two knee-joints above? separating (? nir-ṛ) his two back-thighs (ján̄ghā), where, forsooth, did they set them in? the two joints of his knees—who indeed understands (cit) that?

verses.sa:
चतुष्टयं युजते संहितान्तं जानुभ्यामूर्ध्वं शिथिरं कबन्धम् ।
श्रोणी यदूरू क उ तज्जजान याभ्यां कुसिन्धं सुदृढं बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
chatushtayam yujate samhitantam janubhyamurdhvam shithiram kabandham |
shroni yaduru ka u tajjajana yabhyam kusindham sudridham babhuva ||
verses.en: There is joined, fourfold (cátuṣṭaya), with closed (sáṁhita-) ends, above the two knees, the pliant (çithirá) trunk; what the hips are, the thighs—who indeed produced (jan) that, by which the body (kúsindha) became very firm?

verses.sa:
कति देवाः कतमे त आसन् य उरो ग्रीवाश्चिक्युः पुरुषस्य ।
कति स्तनौ व्यदधुः कः कफोदौ कति स्कन्धान् कति पृष्टीरचिन्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
kati devah katame ta asan ya uro grivashchikyuh purushasya |
kati stanau vyadadhuh kah kaphodau kati skandhan kati prishtirachinvan ||
verses.en: How many gods [and] which were they, who gathered (ci) the breast, the neck-bones of man? how many disposed the two teats? who the two collar-bones (? kaphoḍá)? how many gathered the shoulder-bones (pl.)? how many the ribs?

verses.sa:
को अस्य बाहू समभरद्वीर्यां करवादिति ।
अंसौ को अस्य तद्देवः कुसिन्धे अध्या दधौ ॥
verses.rom:
ko asya bahu samabharadviryam karavaditi |
amsau ko asya taddevah kusindhe adhya dadhau ||
verses.en: Who brought together his two arms, saying "he must perform heroism"? what god then set on his two shoulders upon the body (kúsindha)?

verses.sa:
कः सप्त खानि वि ततर्द शीर्षणि कर्णाविमौ नासिके चक्षणी मुखम् ।
येषां पुरुत्रा विजयस्य मह्ननि चतुष्पादो द्विपदो यन्ति यामम् ॥
verses.rom:
kah sapta khani vi tatarda shirshani karnavimau nasike chakshani mukham |
yesham purutra vijayasya mahnani chatushpado dvipado yanti yamam ||
verses.en: Who bored out the seven apertures in his head—these ears, the nostrils, the eyes, the mouth? in the might of whose conquest (vijayá) in many places quadrupeds [and] bipeds go their way.

verses.sa:
हन्वोर्हि जिह्वामदधात्पुरूचीमधा महीमधि शिश्राय वाचम् ।
स आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तरपो वसानः क उ तच्चिकेत ॥
verses.rom:
hanvorhi jihvamadadhatpuruchimadha mahimadhi shishraya vacham |
sa a varivarti bhuvaneshvantarapo vasanah ka u tachchiketa ||
verses.en: Since in his jaws he put his ample (purūcī́) tongue, then attached (adhi-çri) [to it] great voice; he rolls greatly on among existences, clothing himself in the waters: who indeed understands that?

verses.sa:
मस्तिष्कमस्य यतमो ललाटं ककाटिकां प्रथमो यः कपालम् ।
चित्वा चित्यं हन्वोः पूरुषस्य दिवं रुरोह कतमः स देवः ॥
verses.rom:
mastishkamasya yatamo lalatam kakatikam prathamo yah kapalam |
chitva chityam hanvoh purushasya divam ruroha katamah sa devah ||
verses.en: Which was that god who [produced] his brain, his forehead, his hindhead (? kakā́ṭikā), who first his skull, who, having gathered a gathering in man's jaws, ascended to heaven?

verses.sa:
प्रियाप्रियाणि बहुला स्वप्नं संबाधतन्द्र्यः ।
आनन्दान् उग्रो नन्दांश्च कस्माद्वहति पूरुषः ॥
verses.rom:
priyapriyani bahula svapnam sambadhatandryah |
anandan ugro nandamshcha kasmadvahati purushah ||
verses.en: Numerous things dear and not dear, sleep, oppressions and wearinesses, delights and pleasures—from where does formidable man bring (vah) them?

verses.sa:
आर्तिरवर्तिर्निर्ऋतिः कुतो नु पुरुषेऽमतिः ।
राद्धिः समृद्धिरव्यृद्धिर्मतिरुदितयः कुतः ॥
verses.rom:
artiravartirnirritih kuto nu purushe'matih |
raddhih samriddhiravyriddhirmatiruditayah kutah ||
verses.en: Whence now in man [come] mishap, ruin, perdition, misery, accomplishment, success, non-failure? whence thought (matí), uprisings (úditi)?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन्न् आपो व्यदधात्विषूवृतः पुरूवृतः सिन्धुसृत्याय जाताः ।
तीव्रा अरुणा लोहिनीस्ताम्रधूम्रा ऊर्ध्वा अवाचीः पुरुषे तिरश्चीः ॥
verses.rom:
ko asminn apo vyadadhatvishuvritah puruvritah sindhusrityaya jatah |
tivra aruna lohinistamradhumra urdhva avachih purushe tirashchih ||
verses.en: Who disposed in him waters, moving apart, much moving, produced for river-running, strong (tīvrá), ruddy, red, dark and turbid, upward, downward, crosswise in man?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन् रूपमदधात्को मह्मानं च नाम च ।
गातुं को अस्मिन् कः केतुं कश्चरित्रानि पूरुषे ॥
verses.rom:
ko asmin rupamadadhatko mahmanam cha nama cha |
gatum ko asmin kah ketum kashcharitrani purushe ||
verses.en: Who set form in him? who both bulk (mahmán) and name? who [set] in him progress (gātú)? who display (ketú)? who [set] behaviors (carítra) in man?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन् प्राणमवयत्को अपानं व्यानमु ।
समानमस्मिन् को देवोऽधि शिश्राय पूरुषे ॥
verses.rom:
ko asmin pranamavayatko apanam vyanamu |
samanamasmin ko devo'dhi shishraya purushe ||
verses.en: Who wove in him breath? who expiration and respiration (vyāná)? what god attached (adhi-çri) conspiration (samāná) to man here?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन् यज्ञमदधादेको देवोऽधि पूरुषे ।
को अस्मिन्त्सत्यं कोऽनृतं कुतो मृत्युः कुतोऽमृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ko asmin yajnamadadhadeko devo'dhi purushe |
ko asmintsatyam ko'nritam kuto mrityuh kuto'mritam ||
verses.en: What one god set sacrifice in man here? who [set] in him truth? who untruth? whence [comes] death? whence the immortal?

verses.sa:
को अस्मै वासः पर्यदधात्को अस्यायुरकल्पयत्।
बलं को अस्मै प्रायच्छत्को अस्याकल्पयज्जवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ko asmai vasah paryadadhatko asyayurakalpayat|
balam ko asmai prayachchhatko asyakalpayajjavam ||
verses.en: Who put about him clothing (vā́sas)? who prepared (kalpay-) his life-time? who extended to him strength? who prepared his swiftness?

verses.sa:
केनापो अन्वतनुत केनाहरकरोद्रुचे ।
उषसं केनान्वैन्द्ध केन सायंभवं ददे ॥
verses.rom:
kenapo anvatanuta kenaharakarodruche |
ushasam kenanvainddha kena sayambhavam dade ||
verses.en: With what did he stretch the waters along? with what did he make the day to shine? with what did he kindle (anu-idh) the dawn? with what did he give the coming-on of evening?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन् रेतो न्यदधात्तन्तुरा तायतामिति ।
मेधां को अस्मिन्न् अध्यौहत्को बाणं को नृतो दधौ ॥
verses.rom:
ko asmin reto nyadadhattantura tayatamiti |
medham ko asminn adhyauhatko banam ko nrito dadhau ||
verses.en: Who put in him seed, saying "let his line be extended"? who conveyed into him wisdom? who gave (dhā) [him] music? who dances?

verses.sa:
केनेमां भूमिमौर्णोत्केन पर्यभवद्दिवम् ।
केनाभि मह्ना पर्वतान् केन कर्माणि पुरुषः ॥
verses.rom:
kenemam bhumimaurnotkena paryabhavaddivam |
kenabhi mahna parvatan kena karmani purushah ||
verses.en: With what did he cover this earth? with what did he surround the sky? by what is man a match for (abhí) mountains in greatness? by what, for deeds?

verses.sa:
केन पर्जन्यमन्वेति केन सोमं विचक्षणम् ।
केन यज्ञं च श्रद्धां च केनास्मिन् निहितं मनः ॥
verses.rom:
kena parjanyamanveti kena somam vichakshanam |
kena yajnam cha shraddham cha kenasmin nihitam manah ||
verses.en: With what does he go after Parjanya? with what [after] the out-looking Soma? with what [after] both sacrifice and faith? by whom was mind put in him?

verses.sa:
केन श्रोत्रियमाप्नोति केनेमं परमेष्ठिनम् ।
केनेममग्निं पूरुषः केन संवत्सरं ममे ॥
verses.rom:
kena shrotriyamapnoti kenemam parameshthinam |
kenemamagnim purushah kena samvatsaram mame ||
verses.en: Wherewith does he obtain one learned in revelation (çrótriya)? wherewith this most exalted one? wherewith does man [obtain] this Agni? wherewith did he measure (make?) the year?

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म श्रोत्रियमाप्नोति ब्रह्मेमं परमेष्ठिनम् ।
ब्रह्मेममग्निं पूरुषो ब्रह्म संवत्सरं ममे ॥
verses.rom:
brahma shrotriyamapnoti brahmemam parameshthinam |
brahmemamagnim purusho brahma samvatsaram mame ||
verses.en: The bráhman obtains one learned in revelation, the bráhman this most exalted one; the bráhman [as] man this Agni; the bráhman measured the year.

verses.sa:
केन देवामनु क्षियति केन दैवजनीर्विशः ।
केनेदमन्यन् नक्षत्रं केन सत्क्षत्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
kena devamanu kshiyati kena daivajanirvishah |
kenedamanyan nakshatram kena satkshatramuchyate ||
verses.en: Wherewith does he dwell upon (? anu-kṣi) the gods? wherewith [upon] the people of the god-folk? wherewith this other asterism? whereby is authority (kṣatrá) called real (sát)?

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म देवामनु क्षियति ब्रह्म दैवजनीर्विशः ।
ब्रह्मेदमन्यन् नक्षत्रं ब्रह्म सत्क्षत्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
brahma devamanu kshiyati brahma daivajanirvishah |
brahmedamanyan nakshatram brahma satkshatramuchyate ||
verses.en: The bráhman dwells upon the gods, the bráhman [upon] the people of the god-folk; the bráhman this other asterism; the bráhman is called real authority.

verses.sa:
केनेयं भूमिर्विहिता केन द्यौरुत्तरा हिता ।
केनेदमूर्ध्वं तिर्यक्चान्तरिक्षं व्यचो हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
keneyam bhumirvihita kena dyauruttara hita |
kenedamurdhvam tiryakchantariksham vyacho hitam ||
verses.en: By whom is this earth disposed? by whom the sky set above? by whom this atmosphere, the expanse, set aloft and across?

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणा भूमिर्विहिता ब्रह्म द्यौरुत्तरा हिता ।
ब्रह्मेदमूर्ध्वं तिर्यक्चान्तरिक्षं व्यचो हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmana bhumirvihita brahma dyauruttara hita |
brahmedamurdhvam tiryakchantariksham vyacho hitam ||
verses.en: By the bráhman is the earth disposed; the bráhman [is] the sky set above, the bráhman this atmosphere, the expanse, set aloft and across.

verses.sa:
मूर्धानमस्य संसीव्याथर्वा हृदयं च यत्।
मस्तिष्कादूर्ध्वः प्रैरयत्पवमानोऽधि शीर्षतः ॥
verses.rom:
murdhanamasya samsivyatharva hridayam cha yat|
mastishkadurdhvah prairayatpavamano'dhi shirshatah ||
verses.en: Atharvan, having sewed together his head, and also (yát) his heart—aloft from the brain the purifying one sent [them] forth, out of the head.

verses.sa:
तद्वा अथर्वणः शिरो देवकोशः समुब्जितः ।
तत्प्राणो अभि रक्षति शिरो अन्नमथो मनः ॥
verses.rom:
tadva atharvanah shiro devakoshah samubjitah |
tatprano abhi rakshati shiro annamatho manah ||
verses.en: Verily that head of Atharvan [is] a god-vessel, pressed together; breath defends that, the head, food, also mind.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो नु सृष्टा३ तिर्यङ्नु सृष्टा३ सर्वा दिशः पुरुष आ बभूवा३ ।
पुरं यो ब्रह्मणो वेद यस्याः पुरुष उच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo nu srishta3 tiryannu srishta3 sarva dishah purusha a babhuva3 |
puram yo brahmano veda yasyah purusha uchyate ||
verses.en: Was he now created upward (ūrdhvá)? [or] was he now created crosswise? did man grow unto (ā-bhū) all the quarters?—he who knoweth the bráhman's stronghold, from which man is [so] called.

verses.sa:
यो वै तां ब्रह्मणो वेदामृतेनावृतां पुरम् ।
तस्मै ब्रह्म च ब्राह्माश्च चक्षुः प्राणं प्रजां ददुः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vai tam brahmano vedamritenavritam puram |
tasmai brahma cha brahmashcha chakshuh pranam prajam daduh ||
verses.en: Whoever indeed knoweth that bráhman's stronghold, covered with amṛ́ta—unto him both the bráhman and the Brahmans have given sight, breath, progeny.

verses.sa:
न वै तं चक्षुर्जहाति न प्राणो जरसः पुरा ।
पुरं यो ब्रह्मणो वेद यस्याः पुरुष उच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
na vai tam chakshurjahati na prano jarasah pura |
puram yo brahmano veda yasyah purusha uchyate ||
verses.en: Him verily sight doth not desert, nor breath, before old age, who knoweth the bráhman's stronghold (púr), from which man (púruṣa) is [so] called.

verses.sa:
अष्टाचक्रा नवद्वारा देवानां पूरयोध्या ।
तस्यां हिरण्ययः कोशः स्वर्गो ज्योतिषावृतः ॥
verses.rom:
ashtachakra navadvara devanam purayodhya |
tasyam hiranyayah koshah svargo jyotishavritah ||
verses.en: Eight-wheeled, nine-doored, is the impregnable stronghold of the gods; in that is a golden vessel, heaven-going (svargá), covered with light.

verses.sa:
तस्मिन् हिरण्यये कोशे त्र्यरे त्रिप्रतिष्ठिते ।
तस्मिन् यद्यक्षमात्मन्वत्तद्वै ब्रह्मविदो विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmin hiranyaye koshe tryare tripratishthite |
tasmin yadyakshamatmanvattadvai brahmavido viduh ||
verses.en: In that golden vessel, three-spoked, having three supports—what soul-possessing monster (yakṣá) there is in it, that verily the knowers of the bráhman know.

verses.sa:
प्रभ्राजमानां हरिणीं यशसा संपरीवृताम् ।
पुरं हिरण्ययीं ब्रह्मा विवेशापराजिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
prabhrajamanam harinim yashasa samparivritam |
puram hiranyayim brahma viveshaparajitam ||
verses.en: The bráhman entered into the resplendent, yellow, golden, unconquered stronghold, that was all surrounded with glory.

verses.sa:
अयं मे वरणो मणिः सपत्नक्षयणो वृषा ।
तेना रभस्व त्वं शत्रून् प्र मृणीहि दुरस्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam me varano manih sapatnakshayano vrisha |
tena rabhasva tvam shatrun pra mrinihi durasyatah ||
verses.en: This varaṇá [is] my rival-destroying, virile (vṛ́ṣan) amulet; with it do thou take hold of thy foes, slaughter thy injurers (durasy-).

verses.sa:
प्रैणान् छृणीहि प्र मृणा रभस्व मणिस्ते अस्तु पुरएता पुरस्तात्।
अवारयन्त वरणेन देवा अभ्याचारमसुराणां श्वःश्वः ॥
verses.rom:
prainan chhrinihi pra mrina rabhasva maniste astu puraeta purastat|
avarayanta varanena deva abhyacharamasuranam shvahshvah ||
verses.en: Crush them, slaughter, take hold; be the amulet thy forerunner in front; the gods by the varaṇá warded off the hostile practice (abhyācārá) of the Asuras from one morrow to another.

verses.sa:
अयं मणिर्वरणो विश्वभेषजः सहस्राक्षो हरितो हिरण्ययः ।
स ते शत्रून् अधरान् पादयाति पूर्वस्तान् दभ्नुहि ये त्वा द्विषन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ayam manirvarano vishvabheshajah sahasraksho harito hiranyayah |
sa te shatrun adharan padayati purvastan dabhnuhi ye tva dvishanti ||
verses.en: This amulet, the varaṇá, all-healing, thousand-eyed, yellow, golden—it shall make thy foes go downward; do thou, in front, damage them that hate thee.

verses.sa:
अयं ते कृत्यां विततां पौरुषेयादयं भयात्।
अयं त्वा सर्वस्मात्पापाद्वरणो वारयिष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ayam te krityam vitatam paurusheyadayam bhayat|
ayam tva sarvasmatpapadvarano varayishyate ||
verses.en: This varaṇá [shall ward off] the witchcraft extended for thee; this shall shield thee against fear arising from men, this against all evil.

verses.sa:
वरणो वारयाता अयं देवो वनस्पतिः ।
यक्ष्मो यो अस्मिन्न् आविष्टस्तमु देवा अवीवरन् ॥
verses.rom:
varano varayata ayam devo vanaspatih |
yakshmo yo asminn avishtastamu deva avivaran ||
verses.en: The varaṇá, this divine forest-tree, shall ward off; the yákṣma that has entered into this man—that have the gods warded off.

verses.sa:
स्वप्नं सुप्त्वा यदि पश्यासि पापं मृगः सृतिं यति धावादजुष्टाम् ।
परिक्षवाच्छकुनेः पापवादादयं मणिर्वरणो वारयिष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
svapnam suptva yadi pashyasi papam mrigah sritim yati dhavadajushtam |
parikshavachchhakuneh papavadadayam manirvarano varayishyate ||
verses.en: If, having slept, thou shalt see an evil dream; if a wild beast (mṛgá) shall run a disagreeable course—from overmuch (? pari-) sneezing, from the evil utterance of a bird (çakúni), this amulet, the varaṇá, shall shield thee.

verses.sa:
अरात्यास्त्वा निर्ऋत्या अभिचारादथो भयात्।
मृत्योरोजीयसो वधाद्वरणो वारयिष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
aratyastva nirritya abhicharadatho bhayat|
mrityorojiyaso vadhadvarano varayishyate ||
verses.en: From the niggard, from perdition, from sorcery, also from fear, from the more violent deadly weapon of death, the varaṇá shall shield thee.

verses.sa:
यन् मे माता यन् मे पिता भ्रातरो यच्च मे स्वा यदेनश्चकृमा वयम् ।
ततो नो वारयिष्यतेऽयं देवो वनस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yan me mata yan me pita bhrataro yachcha me sva yadenashchakrima vayam |
tato no varayishyate'yam devo vanaspatih ||
verses.en: What sin my mother, what my father, and what my own brothers, what we ourselves have done, from that shall this divine forest-tree shield us.

verses.sa:
वरणेन प्रव्यथिता भ्रातृव्या मे सबन्धवः ।
असूर्तं रजो अप्यगुस्ते यन्त्वधमं तमः ॥
verses.rom:
varanena pravyathita bhratrivya me sabandhavah |
asurtam rajo apyaguste yantvadhamam tamah ||
verses.en: Driven (vyath) forth by the varaṇá, my enemies (bhrā́tṛvya) [who are my] kinsmen have gone unto unlighted (? asū́rta) space (rájas); let them go to lowest darkness.

verses.sa:
अरिष्टोऽहमरिष्टगुरायुष्मान्त्सर्वपूरुषः ।
तं मायं वरणो मणिः परि पातु दिशोदिशः ॥
verses.rom:
arishto'hamarishtagurayushmantsarvapurushah |
tam mayam varano manih pari patu dishodishah ||
verses.en: Unharmed [am] I, with unharmed kine, long-lived, having all my men; let this amulet, the varaṇá, protect me, being such, from every quarter.

verses.sa:
अयं मे वरण उरसि राजा देवो वनस्पतिः ।
स मे शत्रून् वि बाधतामिन्द्रो दस्यून् इवासुरान् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam me varana urasi raja devo vanaspatih |
sa me shatrun vi badhatamindro dasyun ivasuran ||
verses.en: This varaṇá on my breast, king, divine forest-tree—let it drive (bādh) away my foes, as Indra the barbarians, the Asuras.

verses.sa:
इमं बिभर्मि वरणमायुष्मान् छतशारदः ।
स मे राष्ट्रं च क्षत्रं च पशून् ओजश्च मे दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
imam bibharmi varanamayushman chhatasharadah |
sa me rashtram cha kshatram cha pashun ojashcha me dadhat ||
verses.en: I bear this varaṇá being long-lived, one of a hundred autumns; may it assign to me both kingdom and authority, to me cattle and force.

verses.sa:
यथा वातो वनस्पतीन् वृक्षान् भनक्त्योजसा ।
एवा सपत्नान् मे भङ्ग्धि पूर्वान् जातामुतापरान् वरणस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vato vanaspatin vrikshan bhanaktyojasa |
eva sapatnan me bhangdhi purvan jatamutaparan varanastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: As the wind breaks with force the trees, the forest-trees, so do thou break my rivals, those born before and after; let the varaṇá defend thee.

verses.sa:
यथा वातश्चाग्निश्च वृक्षान् प्सातो वनस्पतीन् ।
एवा सपत्नान् मे प्साहि पूर्वान् जातामुतापरान् वरणस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vatashchagnishcha vrikshan psato vanaspatin |
eva sapatnan me psahi purvan jatamutaparan varanastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: As both wind and fire devour (psā) the trees, the forest-trees, so do thou devour my rivals, those born etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा वातेन प्रक्षीणा वृक्षाः शेरे न्यर्पिताः ।
एवा सपत्नांस्त्वं मम प्र क्षिणीहि न्यर्पय ।
पूर्वान् जातामुतापरान् वरणस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vatena prakshina vrikshah shere nyarpitah |
eva sapatnamstvam mama pra kshinihi nyarpaya |
purvan jatamutaparan varanastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: As, destroyed by the wind, the trees lie prostrate (nyàrpita), so do thou destroy, prostrate my rivals, those born etc. etc.

verses.sa:
तांस्त्वं प्र छिन्द्धि वरण पुरा दिष्टात्पुरायुषः ।
य एनं पशुषु दिप्सन्ति ये चास्य राष्ट्रदिप्सवः ॥
verses.rom:
tamstvam pra chhinddhi varana pura dishtatpurayushah |
ya enam pashushu dipsanti ye chasya rashtradipsavah ||
verses.en: Them, O varaṇá, do thou cut off (pra-chid), before what is appointed (diṣṭá), before [the end of] their life-time—them who strive to damage him in respect to cattle, and who are intent to damage his kingdom.

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यो अतिभाति यथास्मिन् तेज आहितम् ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha suryo atibhati yathasmin teja ahitam |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As the sun shines exceedingly, as in it brilliancy is set, so let the varaṇá amulet fix (ni-yam) in me fame [and] growth; let it sprinkle me with brilliancy; let it anoint me with glory.

verses.sa:
यथा यशश्चन्द्रमस्यादित्ये च नृचक्षसि ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yashashchandramasyaditye cha nrichakshasi |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As glory [is] in the moon, and in the men-beholding Āditya, so let the varaṇá amulet etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशः पृथिव्यां यथास्मिन् जातवेदसि ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yashah prithivyam yathasmin jatavedasi |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As glory [is] in the earth, as in this Jātavedas, so let the varaṇá amulet etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशः कन्यायां यथास्मिन्त्संभृते रथे ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yashah kanyayam yathasmintsambhrite rathe |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As glory [is] in the maiden, as in this constructed (sámbhṛta) chariot, so let the varaṇá amulet etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशः सोमपीथे मधुपर्के यथा यशः ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yashah somapithe madhuparke yatha yashah |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As glory [is] in Soma-drink, as in honey-mixture [is] glory, so let the varaṇá amulet etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशोऽग्निहोत्रे वषट्कारे यथा यशः ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yasho'gnihotre vashatkare yatha yashah |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As glory [is] in the agnihotrá, as in the váṣaṭ-utterance [is] glory, so let the varaṇá amulet etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशो यजमाने यथास्मिन् यज्ञ आहितम् ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yasho yajamane yathasmin yajna ahitam |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As glory [is] set in the sacrificer, as in this sacrifice, so let the varaṇá amulet etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशः प्रजापतौ यथास्मिन् परमेष्ठिनि ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yashah prajapatau yathasmin parameshthini |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As glory [is] in Prajāpati, as in this most exalted one, so let the varaṇá amulet etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा देवेष्वमृतं यथैषु सत्यमाहितम् ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु ।
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha deveshvamritam yathaishu satyamahitam |
eva me varano manih kirtim bhutim ni yachchhatu |
tejasa ma samukshatu yashasa samanaktu ma ||
verses.en: As in the gods [is] immortality (amṛ́ta), as in them is set truth, so let the varaṇá amulet etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य प्रथमो रथो देवानामपरो रथो वरुणस्य तृतीय इत्।
अहीनामपमा रथ स्थानुमारदथार्षत् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya prathamo ratho devanamaparo ratho varunasya tritiya it|
ahinamapama ratha sthanumaradatharshat ||
verses.en: Indra's [was] the first chariot, the gods' the after chariot, Varuna's the third one; the snakes' chariot, the furthest one (?), hath run against the pillar: then may it come to harm (?).

verses.sa:
दर्भः शोचिस्तरूणकमश्वस्य वारः परुषस्य वारः ।
रथस्य बन्धुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
darbhah shochistarunakamashvasya varah parushasya varah |
rathasya bandhuram ||
verses.en: Darbhá-grass, brightness, young shoot (? tarū́ṇaka); horse's tail-tuft, rough-one's tail-tuft; chariot's seat (? bándhura).

verses.sa:
अव श्वेत पदा जहि पूर्वेण चापरेण च ।
उदप्लुतमिव दार्वहीनामरसं विषं वारुग्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
ava shveta pada jahi purvena chaparena cha |
udaplutamiva darvahinamarasam visham varugram ||
verses.en: Smite down, O white one, with the foot, both the fore and the hind; like water-floated wood, sapless [is] the snakes' poison, fierce water (vā́r).

verses.sa:
अरंघुषो निमज्योन्मज पुनरब्रवीत्।
उदप्लुतमिव दार्वहीनामरसं विषं वारुग्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
aramghusho nimajyonmaja punarabravit|
udaplutamiva darvahinamarasam visham varugram ||
verses.en: The araṁghuṣá, having immerged, having emerged, said again: like water-floated wood, sapless is the snake's poison, fierce water.

verses.sa:
पैद्वो हन्ति कसर्णीलं पैद्वः श्वित्रमुतासितम् ।
पैद्वो रथर्व्याः शिरः सं बिभेद पृदाक्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
paidvo hanti kasarnilam paidvah shvitramutasitam |
paidvo ratharvyah shirah sam bibheda pridakvah ||
verses.en: Pāidva slays the kasarṇī́la (snake), Pāidva the whitish and the black; Pāidva hath split altogether the head of the ratharvī́, of the pṛdākū́.

verses.sa:
पैद्व प्रेहि प्रथमोऽनु त्वा वयमेमसि ।
अहीन् व्यस्यतात्पथो येन स्मा वयमेमसि ॥
verses.rom:
paidva prehi prathamo'nu tva vayamemasi |
ahin vyasyatatpatho yena sma vayamemasi ||
verses.en: Go forth first, O Pāidva; we come after thee; cast thou out the snakes from the road by which we come.

verses.sa:
इदं पैद्वो अजायतेदमस्य परायणम् ।
इमान्यर्वतः पदाहिघ्न्यो वाजिनीवतः ॥
verses.rom:
idam paidvo ajayatedamasya parayanam |
imanyarvatah padahighnyo vajinivatah ||
verses.en: Here was Pāidva born; this [is] his going-away; these [are] the tracks of the snake-slaying vigorous steed.

verses.sa:
संयतं न वि ष्परद्व्यात्तं न सं यमत्।
अस्मिन् क्षेत्रे द्वावही स्त्री च पुमांश्च तावुभावरसा ॥
verses.rom:
samyatam na vi shparadvyattam na sam yamat|
asmin kshetre dvavahi stri cha pumamshcha tavubhavarasa ||
verses.en: What is shut together may it not open; what is opened may it not shut together; in this field [are] two snakes, both a female and a male; those [are] both sapless.

verses.sa:
अरसास इहाहयो ये अन्ति ये च दूरके ।
घनेन हन्मि वृश्चिकमहिं दण्डेनागतम् ॥
verses.rom:
arasasa ihahayo ye anti ye cha durake |
ghanena hanmi vrishchikamahim dandenagatam ||
verses.en: Sapless here [are] the snakes, they that are near and they that are far; with a club (ghaná) I slay the stinger (vṛ́çcika), with a staff the snake that has come.

verses.sa:
अघाश्वस्येदं भेषजमुभयो स्वजस्य च ।
इन्द्रो मेऽहिमघायन्तमहिं पैद्वो अरन्धयत् ॥
verses.rom:
aghashvasyedam bheshajamubhayo svajasya cha |
indro me'himaghayantamahim paidvo arandhayat ||
verses.en: This is the remedy of both, of the ill-horse (aghāçvá) and of the constrictor; the mischievous (aghāy-) snake hath Indra, the snake hath Pāidva put in my power (randhay-).

verses.sa:
पैद्वस्य मन्महे वयं स्थिरस्य स्थिरधाम्नः ।
इमे पश्चा पृदाकवः प्रदीध्यत आसते ॥
verses.rom:
paidvasya manmahe vayam sthirasya sthiradhamnah |
ime pashcha pridakavah pradidhyata asate ||
verses.en: We reverence Pāidva, the staunch one, of staunch abode (-dhā́man); here behind sit pṛ́dākus, plotting forth.

verses.sa:
नष्टासवो नष्टविषा हता इन्द्रेण वज्रिणा ।
जघानेन्द्रो जघ्निमा वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
nashtasavo nashtavisha hata indrena vajrina |
jaghanendro jaghnima vayam ||
verses.en: Of lost lives, of lost poison [are they], slain by the thunderbolt-bearing Indra; Indra hath slain, we have slain.

verses.sa:
हतास्तिरश्चिराजयो निपिष्टासः पृदाकवः ।
दर्विं करिक्रतं श्वित्रं दर्भेष्वसितं जहि ॥
verses.rom:
hatastirashchirajayo nipishtasah pridakavah |
darvim karikratam shvitram darbheshvasitam jahi ||
verses.en: Slain [are] the cross-lined ones, crushed down the pṛ́dākus; slay thou the whitish [snake] that makes a great hood, the black snake, in the darbhá-grasses.

verses.sa:
कैरातिका कुमारिका सका खनति भेषजम् ।
हिरण्ययीभिरभ्रिभिर्गिरीनामुप सानुषु ॥
verses.rom:
kairatika kumarika saka khanati bheshajam |
hiranyayibhirabhribhirgirinamupa sanushu ||
verses.en: The little girl of the Kirātas, she the little one, digs a remedy, with golden shovels, upon the ridges (sā́nu) of the mountains.

verses.sa:
आयमगन् युवा भिषक्पृश्निहापराजितः ।
स वै स्वजस्य जम्भन उभयोर्वृश्चिकस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagan yuva bhishakprishnihaparajitah |
sa vai svajasya jambhana ubhayorvrishchikasya cha ||
verses.en: Hither hath come the young physician, slayer of the spotted ones, unconquered; he verily is a grinder-up of both, the constrictor and the stinger.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मेऽहिमरन्धयन् मित्रश्च वरुणश्च ।
वातापर्जन्योभा ॥
verses.rom:
indro me'himarandhayan mitrashcha varunashcha |
vataparjanyobha ||
verses.en: Indra hath put the snake in my power, [also] both Mitra and Varuṇa, and Vāta ('wind') and Parjanya, both of them.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मेऽहिमरन्धयत्पृदाकुं च पृदाक्वम् ।
स्वजं तिरश्चिराजिं कसर्णीलं दशोनसिम् ॥
verses.rom:
indro me'himarandhayatpridakum cha pridakvam |
svajam tirashchirajim kasarnilam dashonasim ||
verses.en: Indra hath put the snake in my power, the pṛ́dāku and the she-pṛ́dāku, the constrictor, the cross-lined one, the kasarṇī́la, the dáçonasi.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो जघान प्रथमं जनितारमहे तव ।
तेषामु तृह्यमाणानां कः स्वित्तेषामसद्रसः ॥
verses.rom:
indro jaghana prathamam janitaramahe tava |
teshamu trihyamananam kah svitteshamasadrasah ||
verses.en: Indra hath slain first thy progenitor, O snake; of them, being shattered, what forsooth can be their sap?

verses.sa:
सं हि शीर्षाण्यग्रभं पौञ्जिष्ठ इव कर्वरम् ।
सिन्धोर्मध्यं परेत्य व्यनिजमहेर्विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam hi shirshanyagrabham paunjishtha iva karvaram |
sindhormadhyam paretya vyanijamahervisham ||
verses.en: Since I have grasped together their heads, as a fisherman the kárvara; having gone away to the middle of the river, I have washed out the snake's poison.

verses.sa:
अहीनां सर्वेषां विषं परा वहन्तु सिन्धवः ।
हतास्तिरश्चिराजयो निपिष्टासः पृदाकवः ॥
verses.rom:
ahinam sarvesham visham para vahantu sindhavah |
hatastirashchirajayo nipishtasah pridakavah ||
verses.en: The poison of all snakes let the rivers carry away; slain [are] the cross-lined ones, crushed down the pṛ́dākus.

verses.sa:
ओषधीनामहं वृण उर्वरीरिव साधुया ।
नयाम्यर्वतीरिवाहे निरैतु विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
oshadhinamaham vrina urvaririva sadhuya |
nayamyarvatirivahe niraitu visham ||
verses.en: I choose as it were the filaments of herbs successfully; I conduct as it were mares; O snake, let thy poison come out.

verses.sa:
यदग्नौ सूर्ये विषं पृथिव्यामोषधीषु यत्।
कान्दाविषं कनक्नकं निरैत्वैतु ते विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadagnau surye visham prithivyamoshadhishu yat|
kandavisham kanaknakam niraitvaitu te visham ||
verses.en: What poison is in fire, in the sun, what in the earth, in herbs, kāndā-poison, kanáknaka—let thy poison come out; let it come.

verses.sa:
ये अग्निजा ओषधिजा अहीनां ये अप्सुजा विद्युत आबभूवुः ।
येषां जातानि बहुधा महान्ति तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो नमसा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
ye agnija oshadhija ahinam ye apsuja vidyuta ababhuvuh |
yesham jatani bahudha mahanti tebhyah sarpebhyo namasa vidhema ||
verses.en: Whichever of the snakes [are] fire-born, herb-born, whichever came hither (ā-bhū) [as] water-born lightnings; those of which the kinds are variously great—to those serpents would we pay worship with reverence.

verses.sa:
तौदी नामासि कन्या घृताची नाम वा असि ।
अधस्पदेन ते पदमा ददे विषदूषणम् ॥
verses.rom:
taudi namasi kanya ghritachi nama va asi |
adhaspadena te padama dade vishadushanam ||
verses.en: Thou art a girl, tāúdī by name; verily thou art by name ghee-like (ghṛtā́cī); I take beneath thy poison-spoiling track.

verses.sa:
अङ्गादङ्गात्प्र च्यावय हृदयं परि वर्जय ।
अधा विषस्य यत्तेजोऽवाचीनं तदेतु ते ॥
verses.rom:
angadangatpra chyavaya hridayam pari varjaya |
adha vishasya yattejo'vachinam tadetu te ||
verses.en: Remove thou [it] from every limb; make [it] avoid the heart; then, what keenness (téjas) the poison has, let that go downward for thee.

verses.sa:
आरे अभूद्विषमरौद्विषे विषमप्रागपि ।
अग्निर्विषमहेर्निरधात्सोमो निरणयीत्।
दंष्टारमन्वगाद्विषमहिरमृत ॥
verses.rom:
are abhudvishamaraudvishe vishamapragapi |
agnirvishamaherniradhatsomo niranayit|
damshtaramanvagadvishamahiramrita ||
verses.en: He (it ?) hath come to be afar; he hath obstructed the poison; he hath mixed poison in poison; Agni hath put out the snake's poison; Soma hath conducted [it] out; the poison hath gone after the biter; the snake hath died.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौज स्थेन्द्रस्य सह स्थेन्द्रस्य बलं स्थेन्द्रस्य वीर्यं स्थेन्द्रस्य नृम्णं स्थ ।
जिष्णवे योगाय ब्रह्मयोगैर्वो युनज्मि ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balam sthendrasya viryam sthendrasya nrimnam stha |
jishnave yogaya brahmayogairvo yunajmi ||
verses.en: Indra's force are ye; Indra's power are ye; Indra's strength are ye; Indra's heroism are ye; Indra's manliness are ye; unto a conquering junction (yóga) with brahman-junctions I join you.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौज स्थेन्द्रस्य सह स्थेन्द्रस्य बलं स्थेन्द्रस्य वीर्यं स्थेन्द्रस्य नृम्णं स्थ ।
जिष्णवे योगाय क्षत्रयोगैर्वो युनज्मि ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balam sthendrasya viryam sthendrasya nrimnam stha |
jishnave yogaya kshatrayogairvo yunajmi ||
verses.en: Indra's force etc. etc.; unto a conquering junction, with kṣatrá-junctions I join you.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौज स्थेन्द्रस्य सह स्थेन्द्रस्य बलं स्थेन्द्रस्य वीर्यं स्थेन्द्रस्य नृम्णं स्थ ।
जिष्णवे योगायेन्द्रयोगैर्वो युनज्मि ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balam sthendrasya viryam sthendrasya nrimnam stha |
jishnave yogayendrayogairvo yunajmi ||
verses.en: Indra's force etc. etc.; unto a conquering junction, with Indra-junctions I join you.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौज स्थेन्द्रस्य सह स्थेन्द्रस्य बलं स्थेन्द्रस्य वीर्यं स्थेन्द्रस्य नृम्णं स्थ ।
जिष्णवे योगाय सोमयोगैर्वो युनज्मि ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balam sthendrasya viryam sthendrasya nrimnam stha |
jishnave yogaya somayogairvo yunajmi ||
verses.en: Indra's force etc. etc.; unto a conquering junction, with Soma-junctions I join you.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौज स्थेन्द्रस्य सह स्थेन्द्रस्य बलं स्थेन्द्रस्य वीर्यं स्थेन्द्रस्य नृम्णं स्थ ।
जिष्णवे योगायाप्सुयोगैर्वो युनज्मि ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balam sthendrasya viryam sthendrasya nrimnam stha |
jishnave yogayapsuyogairvo yunajmi ||
verses.en: Indra's force etc. etc.; unto a conquering junction, with water-junctions I join you.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौज स्थेन्द्रस्य सह स्थेन्द्रस्य बलं स्थेन्द्रस्य वीर्यं स्थेन्द्रस्य नृम्णं स्थ ।
जिष्णवे योगाय विश्वानि मा भूतान्युप तिष्ठन्तु युक्ता म आप स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyauja sthendrasya saha sthendrasya balam sthendrasya viryam sthendrasya nrimnam stha |
jishnave yogaya vishvani ma bhutanyupa tishthantu yukta ma apa stha ||
verses.en: Indra's force etc. etc.; unto a conquering junction; let all existences wait upon (upa-sthā) me; joined to me are ye, O waters.

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्भाग स्थ अपां शुक्रमापो देवीर्वर्चो अस्मासु धत्त ।
प्रजापतेर्वो धाम्नास्मै लोकाय सादये ॥
verses.rom:
agnerbhaga stha apam shukramapo devirvarcho asmasu dhatta |
prajapatervo dhamnasmai lokaya sadaye ||
verses.en: Agni's portion are ye, sperm (? çukrám) of the waters, O heavenly waters; put ye splendor in us; with the ordinance (dhā́man) of Prajāpati I set you for this world.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य भाग स्थ अपां शुक्रमापो देवीर्वर्चो अस्मासु धत्त ।
प्रजापतेर्वो धाम्नास्मै लोकाय सादये ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya bhaga stha apam shukramapo devirvarcho asmasu dhatta |
prajapatervo dhamnasmai lokaya sadaye ||
verses.en: Indra's portion are ye, sperm of the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सोमस्य भाग स्थ अपां शुक्रमापो देवीर्वर्चो अस्मासु धत्त ।
प्रजापतेर्वो धाम्नास्मै लोकाय सादये ॥
verses.rom:
somasya bhaga stha apam shukramapo devirvarcho asmasu dhatta |
prajapatervo dhamnasmai lokaya sadaye ||
verses.en: Soma's portion are ye, sperm of the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वरुणस्य भाग स्थ अपां शुक्रमापो देवीर्वर्चो अस्मासु धत्त ।
प्रजापतेर्वो धाम्नास्मै लोकाय सादये ॥
verses.rom:
varunasya bhaga stha apam shukramapo devirvarcho asmasu dhatta |
prajapatervo dhamnasmai lokaya sadaye ||
verses.en: Varuṇa's portion are ye, sperm of the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
मित्रावरुणयोर्भाग स्थ अपां शुक्रमापो देवीर्वर्चो अस्मासु धत्त ।
प्रजापतेर्वो धाम्नास्मै लोकाय सादये ॥
verses.rom:
mitravarunayorbhaga stha apam shukramapo devirvarcho asmasu dhatta |
prajapatervo dhamnasmai lokaya sadaye ||
verses.en: Mitra-and-Varuṇa's portion are ye, sperm of the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमस्य भाग स्थ अपां शुक्रमापो देवीर्वर्चो अस्मासु धत्त ।
प्रजापतेर्वो धाम्नास्मै लोकाय सादये ॥
verses.rom:
yamasya bhaga stha apam shukramapo devirvarcho asmasu dhatta |
prajapatervo dhamnasmai lokaya sadaye ||
verses.en: Yama's portion are ye, sperm of the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
पितॄणां भाग स्थ अपां शुक्रमापो देवीर्वर्चो अस्मासु धत्त ।
प्रजापतेर्वो धाम्नास्मै लोकाय सादये ॥
verses.rom:
pitrinam bhaga stha apam shukramapo devirvarcho asmasu dhatta |
prajapatervo dhamnasmai lokaya sadaye ||
verses.en: The Fathers' portion are ye, sperm of the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
देवस्य सवितुर्भाग स्थ अपां शुक्रमापो देवीर्वर्चो अस्मासु धत्त ।
प्रजापतेर्वो धाम्नास्मै लोकाय सादये ॥
verses.rom:
devasya saviturbhaga stha apam shukramapo devirvarcho asmasu dhatta |
prajapatervo dhamnasmai lokaya sadaye ||
verses.en: God Savitar's portion are ye, sperm of the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यो व आपोऽपां भागोऽप्स्वन्तर्यजुष्यो देवयजनः ।
इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि ।
तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
तं वधेयं तं स्तृषीयानेन ब्रह्मणानेन कर्मणानया मेन्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo va apo'pam bhago'psvantaryajushyo devayajanah |
idam tamati srijami tam mabhyavanikshi |
tena tamabhyatisrijamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
tam vadheyam tam strishiyanena brahmananena karmananaya menya ||
verses.en: What of you, O waters, is the portion of waters within the waters, of the nature of sacrificial formula, sacrificing to the gods, that now I let go; that let me not wash down against myself; that do we let go against him who hates us, whom we hate; him may I slay (vadh), him may I lay low, with this spell (bráhman), with this act, with this weapon (mení).

verses.sa:
यो व आपोऽपामूर्मिरप्स्वन्तर्यजुष्यो देवयजनः ।
इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि ।
तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
तं वधेयं तं स्तृषीयानेन ब्रह्मणानेन कर्मणानया मेन्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo va apo'pamurmirapsvantaryajushyo devayajanah |
idam tamati srijami tam mabhyavanikshi |
tena tamabhyatisrijamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
tam vadheyam tam strishiyanena brahmananena karmananaya menya ||
verses.en: What of you, O waters, is the wave of the waters within the waters, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यो व आपोऽपां वत्सोऽप्स्वन्तर्यजुष्यो देवयजनः ।
इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि ।
तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
तं वधेयं तं स्तृषीयानेन ब्रह्मणानेन कर्मणानया मेन्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo va apo'pam vatso'psvantaryajushyo devayajanah |
idam tamati srijami tam mabhyavanikshi |
tena tamabhyatisrijamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
tam vadheyam tam strishiyanena brahmananena karmananaya menya ||
verses.en: What of you, O waters, is the young (vatsá) of the waters within the waters, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यो व आपोऽपां वृषभोऽप्स्वन्तर्यजुष्यो देवयजनः ॥ इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि ।
तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥ तं वधेयं तं स्तृषीयानेन ब्रह्मणानेन कर्मणानया मेन्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo va apo'pam vrishabho'psvantaryajushyo devayajanah || idam tamati srijami tam mabhyavanikshi |
tena tamabhyatisrijamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah || tam vadheyam tam strishiyanena brahmananena karmananaya menya ||
verses.en: What of you, O waters, is the bull of the waters within the waters etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यो व आपोऽपां हिरण्यगर्भोऽप्स्वन्तर्यजुष्यो देवयजनः ।
इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि ।
तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
तं वधेयं तं स्तृषीयानेन ब्रह्मणानेन कर्मणानया मेन्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo va apo'pam hiranyagarbho'psvantaryajushyo devayajanah |
idam tamati srijami tam mabhyavanikshi |
tena tamabhyatisrijamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
tam vadheyam tam strishiyanena brahmananena karmananaya menya ||
verses.en: What of you, O waters, is the golden embryo of the waters within the waters, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यो व आपोऽपामश्मा पृश्निर्दिव्योऽप्स्वन्तर्यजुष्यो देवयजनः ।
इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि ।
तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
तं वधेयं तं स्तृषीयानेन ब्रह्मणानेन कर्मणानया मेन्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo va apo'pamashma prishnirdivyo'psvantaryajushyo devayajanah |
idam tamati srijami tam mabhyavanikshi |
tena tamabhyatisrijamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
tam vadheyam tam strishiyanena brahmananena karmananaya menya ||
verses.en: What of you, O waters, is the heavenly spotted stone of the waters within the waters, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यो व आपोऽपामग्नयोऽप्स्वन्तर्यजुष्यो देवयजनः ।
इदं तमति सृजामि तं माभ्यवनिक्षि ।
तेन तमभ्यतिसृजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
तं वधेयं तं स्तृषीयानेन ब्रह्मणानेन कर्मणानया मेन्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo va apo'pamagnayo'psvantaryajushyo devayajanah |
idam tamati srijami tam mabhyavanikshi |
tena tamabhyatisrijamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
tam vadheyam tam strishiyanena brahmananena karmananaya menya ||
verses.en: What of you, O waters, are the fires of the waters within the waters, of the nature of sacrificial formula, sacrificing to the gods, them now I let go; them let me not wash down against myself; them we let go against him who hates us, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यदर्वाचीनं त्रैहायणादनृतं किं चोदिम ।
आपो मा तस्मात्सर्वस्माद्दुरितात्पान्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadarvachinam traihayanadanritam kim chodima |
apo ma tasmatsarvasmadduritatpantvamhasah ||
verses.en: What untruth soever we have spoken since a three years' period,—let the waters protect me from all that difficulty, from distress.

verses.sa:
समुद्रं वः प्र हिणोमि स्वां योनिमपीतन ।
अरिष्टाः सर्वहायसो मा च नः किं चनाममत् ॥
verses.rom:
samudram vah pra hinomi svam yonimapitana |
arishtah sarvahayaso ma cha nah kim chanamamat ||
verses.en: I send you forth to the ocean; go ye unto your own lair; uninjured, of completed years (?); and let nothing whatever ail (am) us.

verses.sa:
अरिप्रा आपो अप रिप्रमस्मत्।
प्रास्मदेनो दुरितं सुप्रतीकाः प्र दुष्वप्न्यं प्र मलं वहन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
aripra apo apa ripramasmat|
prasmadeno duritam supratikah pra dushvapnyam pra malam vahantu ||
verses.en: Free from defilement (-riprá) [are] the waters; [let them carry] away from us defilement, forth from us sin, mishap (duritá), they of good aspect; let them carry forth evil dreaming, forth filth.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा पृथिवीसंशितोऽग्नितेजाः ।
पृथिवीमनु वि क्रमेऽहं पृथिव्यास्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnaha prithivisamshito'gnitejah |
prithivimanu vi krame'ham prithivyastam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, earth-sharpened (-sáṁçita), Agni-brightened; after earth I stride out; from earth we disportion him who hates us, whom we hate; let him not live; him let breath quit.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहान्तरिक्षसंशितो वायुतेजाः ।
अन्तरिक्षमनु वि क्रमेऽहमन्तरिक्षात्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnahantarikshasamshito vayutejah |
antarikshamanu vi krame'hamantarikshattam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, atmosphere-sharpened, Vayu-brightened; after atmosphere I stride out; from atmosphere we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा द्यौसंशितः सूर्यतेजाः ।
दिवमनु वि क्रमेऽहं दिवस्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnaha dyausamshitah suryatejah |
divamanu vi krame'ham divastam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, sky-sharpened, sun-brightened; after the sky I stride out; from the sky we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा दिक्संशितो मनस्तेजाः ।
दिशो अनु वि क्रमेऽहं दिग्भ्यस्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnaha diksamshito manastejah |
disho anu vi krame'ham digbhyastam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, quarter-sharpened, mind-brightened; after the quarters I stride out; from the quarters we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहाशासंशितो वाततेजाः ।
आशा अनु वि क्रमेऽहमाशाभ्यस्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnahashasamshito vatatejah |
asha anu vi krame'hamashabhyastam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, region-sharpened, wind-brightened; after the regions I stride out; from the regions we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा ऋक्संशितो सामतेजाः ।
ऋचोऽनु वि क्रमेऽहमृग्भ्यस्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnaha riksamshito samatejah |
richo'nu vi krame'hamrigbhyastam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, verse-(ṛ́c-)sharpened, chant-(sā́man-)brightened; after the verses I stride out; from the verses we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा यज्ञसंशितो ब्रह्मतेजाः ।
यज्ञमनु वि क्रमेऽहं यज्ञात्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnaha yajnasamshito brahmatejah |
yajnamanu vi krame'ham yajnattam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, sacrifice-sharpened, bráhman-brightened; after the sacrifice I stride out; from the sacrifice we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहौषधीसंशितो सोमतेजाः ।
ओषधीरनु वि क्रमेऽहमोषधीभ्यस्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnahaushadhisamshito somatejah |
oshadhiranu vi krame'hamoshadhibhyastam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, herb-sharpened, sóma-brightened; after the herbs I stride out; from the herbs we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहाप्सुसंशितो वरुणतेजाः ।
अपोऽनु वि क्रमेऽहमद्भ्यस्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnahapsusamshito varunatejah |
apo'nu vi krame'hamadbhyastam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, water-sharpened, Varuṇa-brightened; after the waters I stride out; from the waters we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा कृषिसंशितोऽन्नतेजाः ।
कृषिमनु वि क्रमेऽहं कृष्यास्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnaha krishisamshito'nnatejah |
krishimanu vi krame'ham krishyastam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, plowing-sharpened, food-brightened; after plowing I stride out; from plowing we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा प्राणसंशितः पुरुषतेजाः ।
प्राणमनु वि क्रमेऽहं प्राणात्तं निर्भजामो योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
स मा जीवीत्तं प्राणो जहातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh kramo'si sapatnaha pranasamshitah purushatejah |
pranamanu vi krame'ham pranattam nirbhajamo yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
sa ma jivittam prano jahatu ||
verses.en: Vishṇu's stride art thou, rival-slaying, breath-sharpened, man-(púruṣa-)brightened; after breath I stride out; from breath we disportion him who etc. etc.

verses.sa:
जितमस्माकमुद्भिन्नमस्माकमभ्यष्ठां विश्वाः पृतना अरातीः ।
इदमहमामुष्यायणस्यामुष्याः पुत्रस्य वर्चस्तेजः प्राणमायुर्नि वेष्टयामीदमेनमधराञ्चं पादयामि ॥
verses.rom:
jitamasmakamudbhinnamasmakamabhyashtham vishvah pritana aratih |
idamahamamushyayanasyamushyah putrasya varchastejah pranamayurni veshtayamidamenamadharancham padayami ||
verses.en: Ours [is] what is conquered, ours what has shot up; I have withstood (abhi-sthā) all fighters, niggards; now do I involve (ni-veṣṭ) the splendor, brightness, breath, life-time of him of such-and-such lineage, son of such-and-such mother; now do I make him fall (pad) downward.

verses.sa:
सूर्यस्यावृतमन्वावर्ते दक्षिणामन्वावृतम् ।
सा मे द्रविणं यच्छतु सा मे ब्राह्मणवर्चसम् ॥
verses.rom:
suryasyavritamanvavarte dakshinamanvavritam |
sa me dravinam yachchhatu sa me brahmanavarchasam ||
verses.en: I turn after the sun's turn (āvṛ́t), after his turn to the right; let it yield (yam) me property; [let] it [yield] me Brahman-splendor.

verses.sa:
दिशो ज्योतिष्मतीरभ्यावर्ते ।
ता मे द्रविणं यच्छन्तु ता मे ब्राह्मणवर्चसम् ॥
verses.rom:
disho jyotishmatirabhyavarte |
ta me dravinam yachchhantu ta me brahmanavarchasam ||
verses.en: I turn toward the quarters full of light; let them yield me property, let them etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सप्तऋषीन् अभ्यावर्ते ।
ते मे द्रविणं यच्छन्तु ते मे ब्राह्मणवर्चसम् ॥
verses.rom:
saptarishin abhyavarte |
te me dravinam yachchhantu te me brahmanavarchasam ||
verses.en: I turn toward the seven seers; let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माभ्यावर्ते ।
तन् मे द्रविणं यच्छन्तु तन् मे ब्राह्मणवर्चसम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmabhyavarte |
tan me dravinam yachchhantu tan me brahmanavarchasam ||
verses.en: I turn toward the bráhman; let it yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणामभ्यावर्ते ।
ते मे द्रविणं यच्छन्तु ते मे ब्राह्मणवर्चसम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanamabhyavarte |
te me dravinam yachchhantu te me brahmanavarchasam ||
verses.en: I turn toward the Brahmans; let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यं वयं मृगयामहे तं वधै स्तृणवामहै ।
व्यात्ते परमेष्ठिनो ब्रह्मणापीपदाम तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam vayam mrigayamahe tam vadhai strinavamahai |
vyatte parameshthino brahmanapipadama tam ||
verses.en: Whom we hunt, him will we lay low with deadly weapons; by our spell (bráhman) have we made him fall (pad) into the opened mouth of the most exalted one.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरस्य दंष्ट्राभ्यां हेतिस्तं समधादभि ।
इयं तं प्सात्वाहुतिः समिद्देवी सहीयसी ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanarasya damshtrabhyam hetistam samadhadabhi |
iyam tam psatvahutih samiddevi sahiyasi ||
verses.en: The missile hath closed upon him with the two tusks of Vāiçvānara; let this offering (ā́huti) devour him, the very powerful divine fuel.

verses.sa:
राज्ञो वरुणस्य बन्धोऽसि ।
सोऽमुमामुष्यायणममुष्याः पुत्रमन्ने प्राणे बधान ॥
verses.rom:
rajno varunasya bandho'si |
so'mumamushyayanamamushyah putramanne prane badhana ||
verses.en: King Varuṇa's bond art thou; do thou bind so-and-so, of such-and-such lineage, son of such-and-such mother, in food, in breath.

verses.sa:
यत्ते अन्नं भुवस्पत आक्षियति पृथिवीमनु ।
तस्य नस्त्वं भुवस्पते संप्रयच्छ प्रजापते ॥
verses.rom:
yatte annam bhuvaspata akshiyati prithivimanu |
tasya nastvam bhuvaspate samprayachchha prajapate ||
verses.en: What food of thine, O Lord of earth (bhū́), dwells upon the earth (pṛthivī́)—of that, O lord of earth, do thou furnish unto us, O Prajāpati.

verses.sa:
अपो दिव्या अचायिषं रसेन समपृक्ष्महि ।
पयस्वान् अग्न आगमं तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
apo divya achayisham rasena samaprikshmahi |
payasvan agna agamam tam ma sam srija varchasa ||
verses.en: The heavenly waters have I honored; with sap have we been mingled; rich in milk, O Agni, have I come; unite me here with splendor.

verses.sa:
सं माग्ने वर्चसा सृज सं प्रजया समायुषा ।
विद्युर्मे अस्य देवा इन्द्रो विद्यात्सह ऋषिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sam magne varchasa srija sam prajaya samayusha |
vidyurme asya deva indro vidyatsaha rishibhih ||
verses.en: Unite me, O Agni, with splendor, with progeny, with life-time; may the gods know me as such; may Indra know, together with the seers.

verses.sa:
यदग्ने अद्य मिथुना शपतो यद्वाचस्तृष्टं जनयन्त रेभाः ।
मन्योर्मनसः शरव्या जायते या तया विध्य हृदये यातुधानान् ॥
verses.rom:
yadagne adya mithuna shapato yadvachastrishtam janayanta rebhah |
manyormanasah sharavya jayate ya taya vidhya hridaye yatudhanan ||
verses.en: What, O Agni, the pair utter in curses today, what harshness of speech the reciters produce: the shaft that is born of fury of the mind—with that pierce thou the sorcerers in the heart.

verses.sa:
परा शृणीहि तपसा यातुधानान् पराग्ने रक्षो हरसा शृणीहि ।
परार्चिषा मूरदेवां छृणीहि परासुतृपः शोशुचतः शृणीहि ॥
verses.rom:
para shrinihi tapasa yatudhanan paragne raksho harasa shrinihi |
pararchisha muradevam chhrinihi parasutripah shoshuchatah shrinihi ||
verses.en: Crush away the sorcerers with heat; crush away, O Agni, the demon with flame; crush away with burning the false worshipers; crush away the greatly gleaming ones that feed on lives.

verses.sa:
अपामस्मै वज्रं प्र हरामि चतुर्भृष्टिं शीर्षभिद्याय विद्वान् ।
सो अस्याङ्गानि प्र शृणातु सर्वा तन् मे देवा अनु जानन्तु विश्वे ॥
verses.rom:
apamasmai vajram pra harami chaturbhrishtim shirshabhidyaya vidvan |
so asyangani pra shrinatu sarva tan me deva anu janantu vishve ||
verses.en: I, knowing, hurl at this man, to split his head, the four-pointed (-bhṛṣṭí) thunderbolt of the waters; let it crush all his limbs: to this on my part let all the gods assent.

verses.sa:
अरातीयोर्भ्रातृव्यस्य दुर्हार्दो द्विषतः शिरः ।
अपि वृश्चाम्योजसा ॥
verses.rom:
aratiyorbhratrivyasya durhardo dvishatah shirah |
api vrishchamyojasa ||
verses.en: The head of the niggardly (arātīyú) cousin, of the evil-hearted hater, I cut off with force.

verses.sa:
वर्म मह्यमयं मणिः फालाज्जातः करिष्यति ।
पूर्णो मन्थेन मागमद्रसेन सह वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
varma mahyamayam manih phalajjatah karishyati |
purno manthena magamadrasena saha varchasa ||
verses.en: This amulet, born of the plow-share, shall make defense (várman) for me; it hath come to me filled with stir-about, with sap, together with splendor.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा शिक्वः परावधीत्तक्षा हस्तेन वास्या ।
आपस्त्वा तस्मज्जीवलाः पुनन्तु शुचयः शुचिम् ॥
verses.rom:
yattva shikvah paravadhittaksha hastena vasya |
apastva tasmajjivalah punantu shuchayah shuchim ||
verses.en: In that the skilful smith (tákṣan) hath smitten thee away with the hand by a knife, from that let the lively, bright (çúci) waters purify thee, that art bright.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यस्रगयं मणिः श्रद्धां यज्ञं महो दधत्।
गृहे वसतु नोऽतिथिः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyasragayam manih shraddham yajnam maho dadhat|
grihe vasatu no'tithih ||
verses.en: Let this golden-garlanded amulet, bestowing (dhā) faith, sacrifice, greatness, dwell a guest in our house.

verses.sa:
तस्मै घृतं सुरं मध्वन्नमन्नं क्षदामहे ।
स नः पितेव पुत्रेभ्यः श्रेयःश्रेयश्चिकित्सतु भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वो देवेभ्यो मणिरेत्य ॥
verses.rom:
tasmai ghritam suram madhvannamannam kshadamahe |
sa nah piteva putrebhyah shreyahshreyashchikitsatu bhuyobhuyah shvahshvo devebhyo maniretya ||
verses.en: To it we distribute (kṣad) ghee, strong drink, honey, food after food; for us, as a father for his sons, let it provide (cikits-) what is better and better, more and more, morrow after morrow—the amulet, coming from the gods.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तमग्निः प्रत्यमुञ्चत सो अस्मै दुह आज्यं भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirmanim phalam ghritashchutamugram khadiramojase |
tamagnih pratyamunchata so asmai duha ajyam bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet, plow-share, ghee-dripping, the formidable khadirá, Brihaspati bound on, in order to force—that Agni fastened on; it yields (duh) to him sacrificial butter, more and more, morrow after morrow; with that do thou slay thy haters.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तमिन्द्रः प्रत्यमुञ्चतौजसे वीर्याय कम् ।
सो अस्मै बलमिद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirmanim phalam ghritashchutamugram khadiramojase |
tamindrah pratyamunchataujase viryaya kam |
so asmai balamidduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet etc. etc.—that Indra fastened on, in order to force, to heroism; it yields to him strength, more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तं सोमः प्रत्यमुञ्चत महे श्रोत्राय चक्षसे ।
सो अस्मै वर्च इद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirmanim phalam ghritashchutamugram khadiramojase |
tam somah pratyamunchata mahe shrotraya chakshase |
so asmai varcha idduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet etc. etc.—that Soma fastened on, in order to great hearing (çrótra) [and] sight (cákṣas); it yields to him splendor, more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तं सूर्यः प्रत्यमुञ्चत तेनेमा अजयद्दिशः ।
सो अस्मै भूतिमिद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirmanim phalam ghritashchutamugram khadiramojase |
tam suryah pratyamunchata tenema ajayaddishah |
so asmai bhutimidduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet etc. etc.—that the sun fastened on; therewith he conquered these quarters; it yields to him growth (bhū́ti), more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तं बिभ्रच्चन्द्रमा मणिमसुराणां पुरोऽजयद्दानवानां हिरण्ययीः ।
सो अस्मै श्रियमिद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirmanim phalam ghritashchutamugram khadiramojase |
tam bibhrachchandrama manimasuranam puro'jayaddanavanam hiranyayih |
so asmai shriyamidduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet etc. etc.—bearing that amulet, the moon conquered the strongholds of the Asuras, the golden [strongholds] of the Dānavas; it yields to him fortune, more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
सो अस्मै वाजिनमिद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirvataya manimashave |
so asmai vajinamidduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet Brihaspati bound on for the swift wind, that yields him vigor (vā́jina), more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तेनेमां मणिना कृषिमश्विनावभि रक्षतः ।
स भिषग्भ्यां महो दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirvataya manimashave |
tenemam manina krishimashvinavabhi rakshatah |
sa bhishagbhyam maho duhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet Brihaspati bound on for the swift wind, with that amulet the Açvins defend this plowing (kṛṣí); it yields for the two physicians greatness, more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तं बिभ्रत्सविता मणिं तेनेदमजयत्स्वः ।
सो अस्मै सूनृतां दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirvataya manimashave |
tam bibhratsavita manim tenedamajayatsvah |
so asmai sunritam duhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet Brihaspati bound on for the swift wind, Savitar, bearing that amulet, conquered with it this heaven (svàr); it yields to him pleasantness (sūnṛ́tā), more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तमापो बिभ्रतीर्मणिं सदा धावन्त्यक्षिताः ।
स आभ्योऽमृतमिद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirvataya manimashave |
tamapo bibhratirmanim sada dhavantyakshitah |
sa abhyo'mritamidduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet Brihaspati bound on for the swift wind, bearing that amulet the waters run always unexhausted; it yields to them immortality (amṛ́ta), more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तं राजा वरुणो मणिं प्रत्यमुञ्चत शंभुवम् ।
सो अस्मै सत्यमिद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirvataya manimashave |
tam raja varuno manim pratyamunchata shambhuvam |
so asmai satyamidduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet Brihaspati bound on for the swift wind, that healthful amulet king Varuṇa fastened on; it yields to him truth, more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तं देवा बिभ्रतो मणिं सर्वांल्लोकान् युधाजयन् ।
स एभ्यो जितिमिद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirvataya manimashave |
tam deva bibhrato manim sarvamllokan yudhajayan |
sa ebhyo jitimidduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet Brihaspati bound on for the swift wind, bearing that amulet, the gods conquered by fight all worlds; it yields to them conquest, more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तमिमं देवता मणिं प्रत्यमुञ्चन्त शम्भुवम् ।
स आभ्यो विश्वमिद्दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirvataya manimashave |
tamimam devata manim pratyamunchanta shambhuvam |
sa abhyo vishvamidduhe bhuyobhuyah shvahshvastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: What amulet Brihaspati bound on for the swift wind, that healthful amulet here the deities fastened on; it yields to them everything, more and more etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ऋतवस्तमबध्नतार्तवास्तमबध्नत ।
संवत्सरस्तं बद्ध्वा सर्वं भूतं वि रक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
ritavastamabadhnatartavastamabadhnata |
samvatsarastam baddhva sarvam bhutam vi rakshati ||
verses.en: The seasons bound it on; they of the seasons bound it on; the year, having bound it on, defends all existence.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्देशा अबध्नत प्रदिशस्तमबध्नत ।
प्रजापतिसृष्टो मणिर्द्विषतो मेऽधरामकः ॥
verses.rom:
antardesha abadhnata pradishastamabadhnata |
prajapatisrishto manirdvishato me'dharamakah ||
verses.en: The intermediate quarters bound on; the directions bound it on; the amulet created by Prajāpati hath made my haters beneath me (ádhard).

verses.sa:
अथर्वाणो अबध्नताथर्वणा अबध्नत ।
तैर्मेदिनो अङ्गिरसो दस्यूनां बिभिदुः पुरस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
atharvano abadhnatatharvana abadhnata |
tairmedino angiraso dasyunam bibhiduh purastena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: The Atharvans bound on; the descendants of Atharvan bound on; allied (medín) with them, the An̄girases split the strongholds of the barbarians; with it do thou slay thy haters.

verses.sa:
तं धाता प्रत्यमुञ्चत स भूतं व्यकल्पयत्।
तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
tam dhata pratyamunchata sa bhutam vyakalpayat|
tena tvam dvishato jahi ||
verses.en: Dhātar fastened it on; he disposed (vi-kḷp) [all] existence; with it do thou slay thy haters.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम् ।
स मायं मणिरागमद्रसेन सह वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirdevebhyo asurakshitim |
sa mayam maniragamadrasena saha varchasa ||
verses.en: What [amulet] Brihaspati bound on for the gods, a destruction of Asuras—that amulet hath come here to me, together with sap, with splendor.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम् ।
स मायं मणिरागमत्सह गोभिरजाविभिरन्नेन प्रजया सह ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirdevebhyo asurakshitim |
sa mayam maniragamatsaha gobhirajavibhirannena prajaya saha ||
verses.en: What [amulet] etc. etc., together with kine, with goats and sheep, together with food, with progeny.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम् ।
स मायं मणिरागमत्सह व्रीहियवाभ्यां महसा भूत्या सह ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirdevebhyo asurakshitim |
sa mayam maniragamatsaha vrihiyavabhyam mahasa bhutya saha ||
verses.en: What [amulet] etc. etc., together with rice and barley, together with greatness, growth.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम् ।
स मायं मणिरागमन् मधोर्घृतस्य धारया कीलालेन मणिः सह ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirdevebhyo asurakshitim |
sa mayam maniragaman madhorghritasya dharaya kilalena manih saha ||
verses.en: What [amulet] etc. etc., with a stream of honey, of ghee, together with sweet drink—the amulet.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम् ।
स मायं मणिरागमदूर्जया पयसा सह द्रविणेन श्रिया सह ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirdevebhyo asurakshitim |
sa mayam maniragamadurjaya payasa saha dravinena shriya saha ||
verses.en: What [amulet] etc. etc., together with refreshment, with milk, together with property, with fortune.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम् ।
स मायं मणिरागमत्तेजसा त्विष्या सह यशसा कीर्त्या सह ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirdevebhyo asurakshitim |
sa mayam maniragamattejasa tvishya saha yashasa kirtya saha ||
verses.en: What [amulet] etc. etc., together with brightness, with brilliance, together with glory, with fame.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद्बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम् ।
स मायं मणिरागमत्सर्वाभिर्भूतिभिः सह ॥
verses.rom:
yamabadhnadbrihaspatirdevebhyo asurakshitim |
sa mayam maniragamatsarvabhirbhutibhih saha ||
verses.en: What [amulet] etc. etc., together with all growths.

verses.sa:
तमिमं देवता मणिं मह्यं ददतु पुष्टये ।
अभिभुं क्षत्रवर्धनं सपत्नदम्भनं मणिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamimam devata manim mahyam dadatu pushtaye |
abhibhum kshatravardhanam sapatnadambhanam manim ||
verses.en: This amulet here let the deities give to me in order to prosperity—the overpowering, dominion-increasing, rival-damaging amulet.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणा तेजसा सह प्रति मुञ्चामि मे शिवम् ।
असपत्नः सपत्नहा सपत्नान् मेऽधरामकः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmana tejasa saha prati munchami me shivam |
asapatnah sapatnaha sapatnan me'dharamakah ||
verses.en: Together with bráhman, with brightness, I fasten on myself the propitious one; free from rivals, rival-slaying, it hath made my rivals beneath me.

verses.sa:
उत्तरं द्विषतो मामयं मणिः कृणोतु देवजाः ।
यस्य लोका इमे त्रयः पयो दुग्धमुपासते ।
स मायमधि रोहतु मणिः श्रैष्ठ्याय मूर्धतः ॥
verses.rom:
uttaram dvishato mamayam manih krinotu devajah |
yasya loka ime trayah payo dugdhamupasate |
sa mayamadhi rohatu manih shraishthyaya murdhatah ||
verses.en: Let this god-born amulet make me superior to my hater; whose milked-out milk these three worlds worship, let that amulet mount here upon me, in order to supremacy, at the head.

verses.sa:
यं देवाः पितरो मनुष्या उपजीवन्ति सर्वदा ।
स मायमधि रोहतु मणिः श्रैष्ठ्याय मूर्धतः ॥
verses.rom:
yam devah pitaro manushya upajivanti sarvada |
sa mayamadhi rohatu manih shraishthyaya murdhatah ||
verses.en: What gods. Fathers, men, always subsist upon, let that amulet mount here upon me, in order to supremacy, at the head.

verses.sa:
यथा बीजमुर्वरायां कृष्टे फालेन रोहति ।
एवा मयि प्रजा पशवोऽन्नमन्नं वि रोहतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatha bijamurvarayam krishte phalena rohati |
eva mayi praja pashavo'nnamannam vi rohatu ||
verses.en: As seed in a cultivated field (urvárā) grows up in what is dragged with the plow-share, so in me let progeny, cattle, food upon food, grow up.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वा यज्ञवर्धन मणे प्रत्यमुचं शिवम् ।
तं त्वं शतदक्षिण मणे श्रैष्ठ्याय जिन्वतात् ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai tva yajnavardhana mane pratyamucham shivam |
tam tvam shatadakshina mane shraishthyaya jinvatat ||
verses.en: On whom, O sacrifice-increasing amulet, I have fastened thee, propitious, him do thou quicken unto supremacy, O amulet of a hundred sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa:
