एतमिध्मं समाहितं जुषणो अग्ने प्रति हर्य होमैः ।
तस्मिन् विधेम सुमतिं स्वस्ति प्रजां चक्षुः पशून्त्समिद्धे जातवेदसि ब्रह्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
etamidhmam samahitam jushano agne prati harya homaih |
tasmin vidhema sumatim svasti prajam chakshuh pashuntsamiddhe jatavedasi brahmana ||
verses.en: This fuel, laid on together, do thou, O Agni, enjoying, welcome with oblations; in him may we find favor, welfare, progeny, sight, cattle—in Jātavedas kindled with worship (bráhman).

verses.sa:
कस्मिन्न् अङ्गे तपो अस्याधि तिष्ठति कस्मिन्न् अङ्ग ऋतमस्याध्याहितम् ।
क्व व्रतं क्व श्रद्धास्य तिष्ठति कस्मिन्न् अङ्गे सत्यमस्य प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
kasminn ange tapo asyadhi tishthati kasminn anga ritamasyadhyahitam |
kva vratam kva shraddhasya tishthati kasminn ange satyamasya pratishthitam ||
verses.en: In what member of him is penance situated? in what member of him is right (ṛtá) deposited? where is situated [his] vow (vratá), where his faith? in what member of him is truth established?

verses.sa:
कस्मादङ्गाद्दीप्यते अग्निरस्य कस्मादङ्गात्पवते मातरिश्व ।
कस्मादङ्गाद्वि मिमीतेऽधि चन्द्रमा मह स्कम्भस्य मिमानो अङ्गम् ॥
verses.rom:
kasmadangaddipyate agnirasya kasmadangatpavate matarishva |
kasmadangadvi mimite'dhi chandrama maha skambhasya mimano angam ||
verses.en: From what member of him flames Agni? from what member blows (pū) Mātariçvan? from what member doth the moon measure out, measuring the member of great Skambha?

verses.sa:
कस्मिन्न् अङ्गे तिष्ठति भूमिरस्य कस्मिन्न् अङ्गे तिष्ठत्यन्तरिक्षम् ।
कस्मिन्न् अङ्गे तिष्ठत्याहिता द्यौः कस्मिन्न् अङ्गे तिष्ठत्युत्तरं दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
kasminn ange tishthati bhumirasya kasminn ange tishthatyantariksham |
kasminn ange tishthatyahita dyauh kasminn ange tishthatyuttaram divah ||
verses.en: In what member of him is situated the earth? in what member is situated the atmosphere? in what member is the sky set? in what member is situated what is beyond the sky?

verses.sa:
क्व प्रेप्सन् दीप्यत ऊर्ध्वो अग्निः क्व प्रेप्सन् पवते मातरिश्वा ।
यत्र प्रेप्सन्तीरभियन्त्यावृतः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
kva prepsan dipyata urdhvo agnih kva prepsan pavate matarishva |
yatra prepsantirabhiyantyavritah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Whither desiring to attain does Agni flame aloft? whither desiring to attain blows Mātariçvan? whither desiring to attain, the turns (āvṛ́t) go, that Skambha tell [me]: which forsooth is he?

verses.sa:
क्वार्धमासाः क्व यन्ति मासाः संवत्सरेण सह संविदानाः ।
यत्र यन्त्यृतवो यत्रार्तवाः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
kvardhamasah kva yanti masah samvatsarena saha samvidanah |
yatra yantyritavo yatrartavah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Whither go the half-months, whither the months, in concord with the year? whither the seasons go, whither they of the seasons, that Skambha tell [me]: which forsooth is he?

verses.sa:
क्व प्रेप्सन्ती युवती विरूपे अहोरात्रे द्रवतः संविदाने ।
यत्र प्रेप्सन्तीरभियन्त्यापः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
kva prepsanti yuvati virupe ahoratre dravatah samvidane |
yatra prepsantirabhiyantyapah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Whither desiring to attain run in concord the two maidens (yuvatí) of diverse form, day-and-night? whither desiring to attain, the waters go, that Skambha tell [me]: which forsooth is he?

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्त्स्तब्ध्वा प्रजापतिर्लोकान्त्सर्वामधारयत्।
स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yasmintstabdhva prajapatirlokantsarvamadharayat|
skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: In what, having established [them], Prajāpati maintained all the worlds, that Skambha tell [me]: which forsooth is he?

verses.sa:
यत्परममवमं यच्च मध्यमं प्रजापतिः ससृजे विश्वरूपम् ।
कियता स्कम्भः प्र विवेश तत्र यन् न प्राविशत्कियत्तद्बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
yatparamamavamam yachcha madhyamam prajapatih sasrije vishvarupam |
kiyata skambhah pra vivesha tatra yan na pravishatkiyattadbabhuva ||
verses.en: What that was highest, lowest, and what that was midmost Prajāpati created, of all forms—by how much did Skambha enter there? what did not enter, how much was that?

verses.sa:
कियता स्कम्भः प्र विवेश भूतं कियद्भविष्यदन्वाशयेऽस्य ।
एकं यदङ्गमकृणोत्सहस्रधा कियता स्कम्भः प्र विवेश तत्र ॥
verses.rom:
kiyata skambhah pra vivesha bhutam kiyadbhavishyadanvashaye'sya |
ekam yadangamakrinotsahasradha kiyata skambhah pra vivesha tatra ||
verses.en: By how much did Skambha enter the existent? how much of him lies along that which will exist? what one member he made thousand-fold, by how much did Skambha enter there?

verses.sa:
यत्र लोकाम्श्च कोशांश्चापो ब्रह्म जना विदुः ।
असच्च यत्र सच्चान्त स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra lokamshcha koshamshchapo brahma jana viduh |
asachcha yatra sachchanta skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Where men know both worlds and receptacles (kóça), waters, bráhman, within which [are] both the non-existent and the existent—that Skambha tell [me]: which forsooth is he?

verses.sa:
यत्र तपः पराक्रम्य व्रतं धारयत्युत्तरम् ।
ऋतं च यत्र श्रद्धा चापो ब्रह्म समाहिताः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra tapah parakramya vratam dharayatyuttaram |
ritam cha yatra shraddha chapo brahma samahitah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Where penance, striding forth, maintains the higher vow (vratá), where both right and faith, waters, bráhman, are set together, that Skambha etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् भूमिरन्तरिक्षं द्यौर्यस्मिन्न् अध्याहिता ।
यत्राग्निश्चन्द्रमाः सूर्यो वातस्तिष्ठन्त्यार्पिताः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yasmin bhumirantariksham dyauryasminn adhyahita |
yatragnishchandramah suryo vatastishthantyarpitah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: In whom earth, atmosphere, in whom sky is set, where fire, moon, sun, wind stand fixed (ā́rpita), that Skambha etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवा अङ्गे सर्वे समाहिताः ।
स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya trayastrimshaddeva ange sarve samahitah |
skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: In whose member all the thirty-three gods are set together, that Skambha etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्र ऋषयः प्रथमजा ऋचः साम यजुर्मही ।
एकर्षिर्यस्मिन्न् आर्पितः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra rishayah prathamaja richah sama yajurmahi |
ekarshiryasminn arpitah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Where the first-born seers, the verses, the chant, the sacrificial formula, the great one (mahī́); in whom the sole seer is fixed—that Skambha etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्रामृतं च मृत्युश्च पुरुषेऽधि समाहिते ।
समुद्रो यस्य नाड्यः पुरुषेऽधि समाहिताः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yatramritam cha mrityushcha purushe'dhi samahite |
samudro yasya nadyah purushe'dhi samahitah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Where both immortality (amṛ́ta) and death are set together in man (púruṣa), of whom the ocean, the veins (nāḍī́) are set together in man, that Skambha etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यस्य चतस्रः प्रदिशो नाड्यस्तिष्ठन्ति प्रथमाः ।
यज्ञो यत्र पराक्रान्तः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya chatasrah pradisho nadyastishthanti prathamah |
yajno yatra parakrantah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Of whom the four directions are (sthā) the teeming (? prapyasá) veins, where the sacrifice hath strode forth, that Skambha etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ये पुरुषे ब्रह्म विदुस्ते विदुः परमेष्ठिनम् ।
यो वेद परमेष्ठिनं यश्च वेद प्रजापतिम् ।
ज्येष्ठं ये ब्राह्मणं विदुस्ते स्कम्भमनुसंविदुः ॥
verses.rom:
ye purushe brahma viduste viduh parameshthinam |
yo veda parameshthinam yashcha veda prajapatim |
jyeshtham ye brahmanam viduste skambhamanusamviduh ||
verses.en: Whoever know the bráhman in man, they know the most exalted one; whoever knows the most exalted one, and whoever knows Prajāpati, whoever know the chief bráhmaṇa, they know also accordingly (anu-sam-vid) the Skambha.

verses.sa:
यस्य शिरो वैश्वानरश्चक्षुरङ्गिरसोऽभवन् ।
अङ्गानि यस्य यातवः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya shiro vaishvanarashchakshurangiraso'bhavan |
angani yasya yatavah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Whose head [was] Vāiçvānara, [whose] eye the An̄girases were, whose members the familiar demons (yatú)—that Skambha tell [me]: which forsooth is he?

verses.sa:
यस्य ब्रह्म मुखमाहुर्जिह्वां मधुकशामुत ।
विराजमूधो यस्याहुः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya brahma mukhamahurjihvam madhukashamuta |
virajamudho yasyahuh skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Of whom they call bráhman the mouth, the honey-whip the tongue also, of whom they call virā́j the udder—that Skambha etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यस्मादृचो अपातक्षन् यजुर्यस्मादपाकषन् ।
सामानि यस्य लोमान्यथर्वाङ्गिरसो मुखं स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yasmadricho apatakshan yajuryasmadapakashan |
samani yasya lomanyatharvangiraso mukham skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: From whom they fashioned off the verses, from whom they scraped off the sacrificial formula, of whom the chants [are] the hairs (lóman), the Atharvans-and-An̄girases the mouth—that Skambha etc. etc.

verses.sa:
असच्शाखां प्रतिष्ठन्तीं परममिव जना विदुः ।
उतो सन्मन्यन्तेऽवरे ये ते शाखामुपासते ॥
verses.rom:
asachshakham pratishthantim paramamiva jana viduh |
uto sanmanyante'vare ye te shakhamupasate ||
verses.en: The branch of the non-existent, standing forth, people know as in a manner the highest thing; also the lower ones who worship (upa-ās) thy branch think [it?] the existent thing.

verses.sa:
यत्रादित्याश्च रुद्राश्च वसवश्च समाहिताः ।
भूतं च यत्र भव्यं च सर्वे लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yatradityashcha rudrashcha vasavashcha samahitah |
bhutam cha yatra bhavyam cha sarve lokah pratishthitah skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Where both the Ādityas and the Rudras and the Vasus are set together; where both what is and what is to be, [and] all the worlds are established—that Skambha tell [me]: which forsooth is he?

verses.sa:
यस्य त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवा निधिं रक्षन्ति सर्वदा ।
निधिं तमद्य को वेद यं देवा अभिरक्षथ ॥
verses.rom:
yasya trayastrimshaddeva nidhim rakshanti sarvada |
nidhim tamadya ko veda yam deva abhirakshatha ||
verses.en: Of whom the thirty-three gods always defend the treasure (nidhí): that treasure, which, O gods, ye defend, who at present knoweth?

verses.sa:
यत्र देवा ब्रह्मविदो ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठमुपासते ।
यो वै तान् विद्यात्प्रत्यक्षं स ब्रह्मा वेदिता स्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra deva brahmavido brahma jyeshthamupasate |
yo vai tan vidyatpratyaksham sa brahma vedita syat ||
verses.en: Where the bráhman-knowing gods worship the chief bráhman—whoso verily knoweth them eye to eye (pratyákṣam), he may be a Brahman (brahmán), a knower.

verses.sa:
बृहन्तो नाम ते देवा येऽसतः परि जज्ञिरे ।
एकं तदङ्गं स्कम्भस्यासदाहुः परो जनाः ॥
verses.rom:
brihanto nama te deva ye'satah pari jajnire |
ekam tadangam skambhasyasadahuh paro janah ||
verses.en: Great (bṛhánt) by name [are] those gods who were born out of the non-existent; that one member of Skambha people call non-existent beyond.

verses.sa:
यत्र स्कम्भः प्रजनयन् पुराणं व्यवर्तयत्।
एकं तदङ्गं स्कम्भस्य पुराणमनुसंविदुः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra skambhah prajanayan puranam vyavartayat|
ekam tadangam skambhasya puranamanusamviduh ||
verses.en: Where the skambhá, generating forth, rolled out the ancient one, that one member of the skambhá they know also accordingly [as] the ancient one.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवा अङ्गे गात्रा विभेजिरे ।
तान् वै त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवान् एके ब्रहमविदो विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya trayastrimshaddeva ange gatra vibhejire |
tan vai trayastrimshaddevan eke brahamavido viduh ||
verses.en: In whose member the thirty-three gods shared severally the limbs (gā́tra)—those thirty-three gods verily only (éka) the bráhman-knowers know.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यगर्भं परममनत्युद्यं जना विदुः ।
स्कम्भस्तदग्रे प्रासिञ्चद्धिरण्यं लोके अन्तरा ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyagarbham paramamanatyudyam jana viduh |
skambhastadagre prasinchaddhiranyam loke antara ||
verses.en: People know the golden-embryo [as] highest, not to be overcrowed (anatyudyá); the skambhá in the beginning poured forth that gold within the world.

verses.sa:
स्कम्भे लोकाः स्कम्भे तपः स्कम्भेऽध्यृतमाहितम् ।
स्कम्भ त्वा वेद प्रत्यक्षमिन्द्रे सर्वं समाहितम् ॥
verses.rom:
skambhe lokah skambhe tapah skambhe'dhyritamahitam |
skambha tva veda pratyakshamindre sarvam samahitam ||
verses.en: In the skambhá the worlds, in the skambhá penance, in the skambhá right is set; thee, O skambhá, I know plainly [as] set all together in Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रे लोका इन्द्रे तप इन्द्रेऽध्यृतमाहितम् ।
इन्द्रं त्वा वेद प्रत्यक्षं स्कम्भे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
indre loka indre tapa indre'dhyritamahitam |
indram tva veda pratyaksham skambhe sarvam pratishthitam ||
verses.en: In Indra the worlds, in Indra penance, in Indra right is set; thee, O Indra, I know plainly [as] all established in the skambhá.

verses.sa:
नाम नाम्ना जोहवीति पुरा सूर्यात्पुरोषसः ।
यदजः प्रथमं संबभूव स ह तत्स्वराज्यमियाय यस्मान् नान्यत्परमस्ति भूतम् ॥
verses.rom:
nama namna johaviti pura suryatpuroshasah |
yadajah prathamam sambabhuva sa ha tatsvarajyamiyaya yasman nanyatparamasti bhutam ||
verses.en: Name with name he calls aloud, before the sun, before the dawn; as first the goat (? ajá) came into being, he went unto that autocracy beyond which there is nothing else existent.

verses.sa:
यस्य भूमिः प्रमान्तरिक्षमुतोदरम् ।
दिवं यश्चक्रे मूर्धानं तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya bhumih pramantarikshamutodaram |
divam yashchakre murdhanam tasmai jyeshthaya brahmane namah ||
verses.en: Of whom earth is model (pramā́) and atmosphere belly; who made the sky his head—to that chief bráhman be homage.

verses.sa:
यस्य सूर्यश्चक्षुश्चन्द्रमाश्च पुनर्णवः ।
अग्निं यश्चक्र आस्यं तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya suryashchakshushchandramashcha punarnavah |
agnim yashchakra asyam tasmai jyeshthaya brahmane namah ||
verses.en: Of whom the sun is eye, and the moon that grows new again; who made Agni his mouth—to that chief bráhman be homage.

verses.sa:
यस्य वातः प्राणापानौ चक्षुरङ्गिरसोऽभवन् ।
दिशो यश्चक्रे प्रज्ञानीस्तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya vatah pranapanau chakshurangiraso'bhavan |
disho yashchakre prajnanistasmai jyeshthaya brahmane namah ||
verses.en: Of whom the wind [was] breath-and-expiration, [of whom] the An̄girases were the eye; who made the quarters fore-knowing (? prajñā́na)—to that chief bráhman be homage.

verses.sa:
स्कम्भो दाधार द्यावापृथिवी उभे इमे स्कम्भो दाधारोर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
स्कम्भो दाधार प्रदिशः षडुर्वीः स्कम्भ इदं विश्वं भुवनमा विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
skambho dadhara dyavaprithivi ubhe ime skambho dadharorvantariksham |
skambho dadhara pradishah shadurvih skambha idam vishvam bhuvanama vivesha ||
verses.en: The skambhá sustains both heaven-and-earth here; the skambhá sustains the wide atmosphere; the skambhá sustains the six wide directions; into the skambhá hath entered this whole existence (bhúvana).

verses.sa:
यः श्रमात्तपसो जातो लोकान्त्सर्वान्त्समानशे ।
सोमं यश्चक्रे केवलं तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yah shramattapaso jato lokantsarvantsamanashe |
somam yashchakre kevalam tasmai jyeshthaya brahmane namah ||
verses.en: Who, born from toil, from penance, completely attained all worlds; who made soma all his own—to that chief bráhman be homage.

verses.sa:
कथं वातो नेलयति कथं न रमते मनः ।
किमापः सत्यं प्रेप्सन्तीर्नेलयन्ति कदा चन ॥
verses.rom:
katham vato nelayati katham na ramate manah |
kimapah satyam prepsantirnelayanti kada chana ||
verses.en: How does the wind not cease (il)? how does the mind not rest (ram)? why (kím) do the waters, seeking to attain truth, at no time soever cease?

verses.sa:
महद्यक्षं भुवनस्य मध्ये तपसि क्रान्तं सलिलस्य पृष्ठे ।
तस्मिन् छ्रयन्ते य उ के च देवा वृक्षस्य स्कन्धः परित इव शाखाः ॥
verses.rom:
mahadyaksham bhuvanasya madhye tapasi krantam salilasya prishthe |
tasmin chhrayante ya u ke cha deva vrikshasya skandhah parita iva shakhah ||
verses.en: A great monster (yakṣá) in the midst of the creation (bhúvana), strode (? krāntá) in penance on the back of the sea—in it are set (çri) whatever gods there are, like the branches of a tree roundabout the trunk.

verses.sa:
यस्मै हस्ताभ्यां पादाभ्यां वाचा श्रोत्रेण चक्षुषा ।
यस्मै देवाः सदा बलिं प्रयच्छन्ति विमितेऽमितं स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai hastabhyam padabhyam vacha shrotrena chakshusha |
yasmai devah sada balim prayachchhanti vimite'mitam skambham tam bruhi katamah svideva sah ||
verses.en: Unto which with the two hands, with the two feet, with speech, with hearing, with sight; unto which the gods continually render (pra-yam) tribute, unmeasured in the measured out—that skambhá tell [me]: which forsooth is he?

verses.sa:
अप तस्य हतं तमो व्यावृत्तः स पाप्मना ।
सर्वाणि तस्मिन् ज्योतींषि यानि त्रीणि प्रजापतौ ॥
verses.rom:
apa tasya hatam tamo vyavrittah sa papmana |
sarvani tasmin jyotimshi yani trini prajapatau ||
verses.en: Smitten away is his darkness; he is separated from evil; in him. are all the three lights that are in Prājapati.

verses.sa:
यो वेतसं हिरण्ययं तिष्ठन्तं सलिले वेद ।
स वै गुह्यः प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vetasam hiranyayam tishthantam salile veda |
sa vai guhyah prajapatih ||
verses.en: He who knows the golden reed (vetasá) standing in the sea—he verily is in secret Prajāpati.

verses.sa:
तन्त्रमेके युवती विरूपे अभ्याक्रामं वयतः षण्मयूखम् ।
प्रान्या तन्तूंस्तिरते धत्ते अन्या नाप वृञ्जाते न गमातो अन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
tantrameke yuvati virupe abhyakramam vayatah shanmayukham |
pranya tantumstirate dhatte anya napa vrinjate na gamato antam ||
verses.en: A certain pair of maidens, of diverse form, weave, betaking themselves to it, the six-pegged web; the one draws forth the threads (tántu), the other sets [them]; they wrest not off (apa-vṛj), they go not to an end.

verses.sa:
तयोरहं परिनृत्यन्त्योरिव न वि जानामि यतरा परस्तात्।
पुमान् एनद्वयत्युद्गृणन्ति पुमान् एनद्वि जभाराधि नाके ॥
verses.rom:
tayoraham parinrityantyoriva na vi janami yatara parastat|
puman enadvayatyudgrinanti puman enadvi jabharadhi nake ||
verses.en: Of them, as of two women dancing about, I do not distinguish (vi-jñā) which is beyond; a man (púmāṅs), weaves it, ties [it] up; a man hath borne it about upon the firmament (nā́ka).

verses.sa: इमे मयूखा उप तस्तभुर्दिवं सामानि चक्रुस्तसराणि वातवे ॥
verses.rom: ime mayukha upa tastabhurdivam samani chakrustasarani vatave ||
verses.en: These pegs propped up the sky; the chants they made shuttles for weaving.

verses.sa:
यो भूतं च भव्यं च सर्वं यश्चाधितिष्ठति ।
स्वर्यस्य च केवलं तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yo bhutam cha bhavyam cha sarvam yashchadhitishthati |
svaryasya cha kevalam tasmai jyeshthaya brahmane namah ||
verses.en: He who is set over both what is and what is to be and everything, and whose alone is the heaven—to that chief bráhman be homage.

verses.sa:
स्कम्भेनेमे विष्टभिते द्यौश्च भूमिश्च तिष्ठतः ।
स्कम्भ इदं सर्वमात्मन्वद्यत्प्राणन् निमिषच्च यत् ॥
verses.rom:
skambheneme vishtabhite dyaushcha bhumishcha tishthatah |
skambha idam sarvamatmanvadyatpranan nimishachcha yat ||
verses.en: By the skambhá these two stand fixed apart, both sky and earth; in the skambhá [is] all this that has soul, what [is] breathing and what winking.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो ह प्रजा अत्यायमायन् न्यन्या अर्कमभितोऽविशन्त ।
बृहन् ह तस्थौ रजसो विमानो हरितो हरिणीरा विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
tisro ha praja atyayamayan nyanya arkamabhito'vishanta |
brihan ha tasthau rajaso vimano harito harinira vivesha ||
verses.en: Three offspring (prajā́) went an over-going; others settled (ni-viç) about the sun (? arká); great stood the traverser (vimā́na) of space (rájas); the yellow one (m.) entered into the yellow ones (f.).

verses.sa:
द्वादश प्रधयश्चक्रमेकं त्रीणि नभ्यानि क उ तच्चिकेत ।
तत्राहतास्त्रीणि शतानि शङ्कवः षष्टिश्च खीला अविचाचला ये ॥
verses.rom:
dvadasha pradhayashchakramekam trini nabhyani ka u tachchiketa |
tatrahatastrini shatani shankavah shashtishcha khila avichachala ye ||
verses.en: Twelve fellies, one wheel, three naves—who understands that? therein are inserted (ā́hata) three hundred and sixty pins (çan̄kú), pegs (? khī́la) that are immovable.

verses.sa:
इदं सवितर्वि जानीहि षड्यमा एक एकजः ।
तस्मिन् हापित्वमिच्छन्ते य एषामेक एकजः ॥
verses.rom:
idam savitarvi janihi shadyama eka ekajah |
tasmin hapitvamichchhante ya eshameka ekajah ||
verses.en: This, O Savitar, do thou distinguish: six [are] twins, one [is] sole-born; they seek participation (apitvá) in him who of them is the sole sole-born.

verses.sa:
आविः सन् निहितं गुहा जरन् नाम महत्पदम् ।
तत्रेदं सर्वमार्पितमेजत्प्राणत्प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
avih san nihitam guha jaran nama mahatpadam |
tatredam sarvamarpitamejatpranatpratishthitam ||
verses.en: Being manifest (āvís), [it is] deposited in secret; the great track (padá), "aged" (járat) by name; there is set (ā́rpita) this all, [there is] established what stirs, what breathes.

verses.sa:
एकचक्रं वर्तत एकनेमि सहस्राक्षरं प्र पुरो नि पश्चा ।
अर्धेन विश्वं भुवनं जजान यदस्यार्धं क्व तद्बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
ekachakram vartata ekanemi sahasraksharam pra puro ni pashcha |
ardhena vishvam bhuvanam jajana yadasyardham kva tadbabhuva ||
verses.en: One-wheeled it rolls, one-rimmed, thousand-syllabled, forth in front, down behind; with a half it has generated all existence; what its [other] half is—what has become of that?

verses.sa:
पञ्चवाही वहत्यग्रमेषां प्रष्टयो युक्ता अनुसंवहन्ति ।
अयातमस्य ददृशे न यातं परं नेदीयोऽवरं दवीयः ॥
verses.rom:
panchavahi vahatyagramesham prashtayo yukta anusamvahanti |
ayatamasya dadrishe na yatam param nediyo'varam daviyah ||
verses.en: One carrying five carries the summit (ágra) of them; side-horses, harnessed, carry also along; what is not gone of it was seen, not what is gone; the higher thing [is] closer, the lower more distant.

verses.sa:
तिर्यग्बिलश्चमस ऊर्ध्वबुध्नस्तस्मिन् यशो निहितं विश्वरूपम् ।
तदासत ऋषयः सप्त साकं ये अस्य गोपा महतो बभूवुः ॥
verses.rom:
tiryagbilashchamasa urdhvabudhnastasmin yasho nihitam vishvarupam |
tadasata rishayah sapta sakam ye asya gopa mahato babhuvuh ||
verses.en: A bowl (camasá) with orifice sideways, bottom-side up—in it is deposited glory of all forms; there sit together the seven seers, who have become the keepers of it, the great one.

verses.sa:
या पुरस्ताद्युज्यते या च पश्चाद्या विश्वतो युज्यते या च सर्वतः ।
यया यज्ञः प्राङ्तायते तां त्वा पृच्छामि कतमा सर्चाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya purastadyujyate ya cha pashchadya vishvato yujyate ya cha sarvatah |
yaya yajnah prantayate tam tva prichchhami katama sarcham ||
verses.en: The one which is applied (yuj) in front and which behind, which is applied in all cases and which in every case, by which the sacrifice is extended forward—that I ask of thee: which one of the verses is it?

verses.sa:
यदेजति पतति यच्च तिष्ठति प्राणदप्राणन् निमिषच्च यद्भुवत्।
तद्दाधार पृथिवीं विश्वरूपं तत्संभूय भवत्येकमेव ॥
verses.rom:
yadejati patati yachcha tishthati pranadapranan nimishachcha yadbhuvat|
taddadhara prithivim vishvarupam tatsambhuya bhavatyekameva ||
verses.en: What stirs, flies, and what stands, and what is breathing, not breathing, winking—that, all-formed, sustains the earth; that, combining, becomes one only.

verses.sa:
अनन्तं विततं पुरुत्रानन्तमन्तवच्चा समन्ते ।
ते नाकपालश्चरति विचिन्वन् विद्वान् भूतमुत भव्यमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
anantam vitatam purutranantamantavachcha samante |
te nakapalashcharati vichinvan vidvan bhutamuta bhavyamasya ||
verses.en: What is endless, stretched out on many sides; what is endless, and what has an end, ending together—these (two) the lord of the firmament keeps (car) separating (vi-ci), knowing what is and what shall be of it.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिश्चरति गर्भे अन्तरदृश्यमानो बहुधा वि जायते ।
अर्धेन विश्वं भुवनं जजान यदस्यार्धं कतमः स केतुः ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatishcharati garbhe antaradrishyamano bahudha vi jayate |
ardhena vishvam bhuvanam jajana yadasyardham katamah sa ketuh ||
verses.en: Prajāpati goes about (car) within the womb; not being seen, he is manifoldly born (vi-jā); with a half he has generated all existence; what his [other] half is—which sign is that?

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं भरन्तमुदकं कुम्भेनेवोदहार्यम् ।
पश्यन्ति सर्वे चक्षुषा न सर्वे मनसा विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvam bharantamudakam kumbhenevodaharyam |
pashyanti sarve chakshusha na sarve manasa viduh ||
verses.en: Him bearing water aloft, as a water-bearer (f.) with a vessel (kumbhá), all see with the eye, not all know with the mind.

verses.sa:
दूरे पूर्णेन वसति दूर ऊनेन हीयते ।
महद्यक्षं भुवनस्य मध्ये तस्मै बलिं राष्ट्रभृतो भरन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
dure purnena vasati dura unena hiyate |
mahadyaksham bhuvanasya madhye tasmai balim rashtrabhrito bharanti ||
verses.en: In the distance it dwells with the full one, in the distance it is abandoned by the deficient one—the great monster (yakṣá) in the midst of existence; to it the kingdom-bearers bear tribute.

verses.sa:
यतः सूर्यः उदेत्यस्तं यत्र च गच्छति ।
तदेव मन्येऽहं ज्येष्ठं तदु नात्येति किं चन ॥
verses.rom:
yatah suryah udetyastam yatra cha gachchhati |
tadeva manye'ham jyeshtham tadu natyeti kim chana ||
verses.en: Whence the sun arises, and where he goes to rest—that same I think the chief (jyeṣṭhá); that nothing whatever surpasses.

verses.sa:
ये अर्वाङ्मध्य उत वा पुराणं वेदं विद्वांसमभितो वदन्ति ।
आदित्यमेव ते परि वदन्ति सर्वे अग्निं द्वितीयं त्रिवृतं च हंसम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye arvanmadhya uta va puranam vedam vidvamsamabhito vadanti |
adityameva te pari vadanti sarve agnim dvitiyam trivritam cha hamsam ||
verses.en: They who hitherward, in the middle, or also anciently, speak round about him who knows the Veda, they all speak around the sun (ādityá), Agni [as] second, and the threefold swan (haṅsá).

verses.sa:
सहस्राह्ण्यं वियतावस्य पक्षौ हरेर्हंसस्य पततः स्वर्गम् ।
स देवान्त्सर्वान् उरस्युपदद्य संपश्यन् याति भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrahnyam viyatavasya pakshau harerhamsasya patatah svargam |
sa devantsarvan urasyupadadya sampashyan yati bhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en: A thousand days' journey [are] expanded (vi-yam) the wings of him, of the yellow swan flying to heaven (svargá); he, putting all the gods in his breast, goes, viewing together all existences.

verses.sa:
सत्येनोर्ध्वस्तपति ब्रह्मणार्वाङ्वि पश्यति ।
प्राणेन तिर्यङ्प्राणति यस्मिन् ज्येष्ठमधि श्रितम् ॥
verses.rom:
satyenordhvastapati brahmanarvanvi pashyati |
pranena tiryanpranati yasmin jyeshthamadhi shritam ||
verses.en: By truth he burns aloft; by bráhman he looks abroad hitherward, by breath he breathes crosswise—he on whom rests (çritá) the chief thing.

verses.sa:
यो वै ते विद्यादरणी याभ्यां निर्मथ्यते वसु ।
स विद्वान् ज्येष्ठं मन्येत स विद्याद्ब्राह्मणं महत् ॥
verses.rom:
yo vai te vidyadarani yabhyam nirmathyate vasu |
sa vidvan jyeshtham manyeta sa vidyadbrahmanam mahat ||
verses.en: Whoever indeed knows those two churning-sticks, with which is churned out what is good (vásu), he may think himself to know the chief thing; he may know the great bráhmaṇa neut..

verses.sa:
अपादग्रे समभवत्सो अग्रे स्वराभरत्।
चतुष्पाद्भूत्वा भोग्यः सर्वमादत्त भोजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
apadagre samabhavatso agre svarabharat|
chatushpadbhutva bhogyah sarvamadatta bhojanam ||
verses.en: Footless came he into being in the beginning; he in the beginning brought the heaven (svàr); having become four-footed, enjoyable, he took to himself all enjoyment (bhójana),

verses.sa:
भोग्यो भवदथो अन्नमदद्बहु ।
यो देवमुत्तरावन्तमुपासातै सनातनम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhogyo bhavadatho annamadadbahu |
yo devamuttaravantamupasatai sanatanam ||
verses.en: Enjoyable shall he become, likewise shall he eat much food, who shall worship (upa-ās) the everlasting god who gives superiority (uttarā́vant).

verses.sa:
सनातनमेनमाहुरुताद्य स्यात्पुनर्णवः ।
अहोरात्रे प्र जायेते अन्यो अन्यस्य रूपयोः ॥
verses.rom:
sanatanamenamahurutadya syatpunarnavah |
ahoratre pra jayete anyo anyasya rupayoh ||
verses.en: Everlasting they call him, also may he be at present ever-renewed; day and night are generated (pra-jā) in each other's forms.

verses.sa:
शतं सहस्रमयुतं न्यर्बुदमसंख्येयं स्वमस्मिन् निविष्टम् ।
तदस्य घ्नन्त्यभिपश्यत एव तस्माद्देवो रोचतेष एतत् ॥
verses.rom:
shatam sahasramayutam nyarbudamasamkhyeyam svamasmin nivishtam |
tadasya ghnantyabhipashyata eva tasmaddevo rochatesha etat ||
verses.en: A hundred, a thousand, a myriad, a hundred million, an innumerable [number], is his own entered into him; that of him they slay, even as he looks on; therefore this god shines (ruc) thus.

verses.sa:
बालादेकमणीयस्कमुतैकं नेव दृश्यते ।
ततः परिष्वजीयसी देवता सा मम प्रिया ॥
verses.rom:
baladekamaniyaskamutaikam neva drishyate |
tatah parishvajiyasi devata sa mama priya ||
verses.en: One thing is more minute (áṇu) than a child (bā́la), also one is hardly (né ’va) seen; than that a more embracing deity, is she dear to me.

verses.sa:
इयं कल्याण्यजरा मर्त्यस्यामृता गृहे ।
यस्मै कृता शये स यश्चकार जजार सः ॥
verses.rom:
iyam kalyanyajara martyasyamrita grihe |
yasmai krita shaye sa yashchakara jajara sah ||
verses.en: This beautiful one (f.) [is] unaging, an immortal in the house of a mortal; for whom she [was] made, he lies; he who made [her] grew old.

verses.sa:
त्वं स्त्री त्वं पुमान् असि त्वं कुमार उत वा कुमारी॥
त्वं जीर्णो दण्डेन वञ्चसि त्वं जातो भवसि विश्वतोमुखः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam stri tvam puman asi tvam kumara uta va kumari||
tvam jirno dandena vanchasi tvam jato bhavasi vishvatomukhah ||
verses.en: Thou art woman, thou [art] man, thou boy, or also girl; thou, when aged, totterest (vañc) with a staff; thou, when born, becomest facing all ways.

verses.sa:
उतैषां पितोत वा पुत्र एषामुतैषां ज्येष्ठ उत वा कनिष्ठः ।
एको ह देवो मनसि प्रविष्टः प्रथमो जातः स उ गर्भे अन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
utaisham pitota va putra eshamutaisham jyeshtha uta va kanishthah |
eko ha devo manasi pravishtah prathamo jatah sa u garbhe antah ||
verses.en: Both their father, or also their son; both the chief or also the meanest (kaniṣṭhá) of them; the one god, who has entered into the mind, born the first, and he within the womb.

verses.sa:
पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदचति पूर्णं पूर्णेन सिच्यते ।
उतो तदद्य विद्याम यतस्तत्परिषिच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
purnatpurnamudachati purnam purnena sichyate |
uto tadadya vidyama yatastatparishichyate ||
verses.en: The full from the full he bends up (ud-ac); the full is poured with the full; also that may we know today, whence that is poured out.

verses.sa:
एषा सनत्नी सनमेव जातैषा पुराणी परि सर्वं बभूव ।
मही देव्युषसो विभाती सैकेनैकेन मिषता वि चष्टे ॥
verses.rom:
esha sanatni sanameva jataisha purani pari sarvam babhuva |
mahi devyushaso vibhati saikenaikena mishata vi chashte ||
verses.en: She, everlasting, born indeed of old, she, ancient, encompassed (pari-bhū) all; the great goddess of the dawn, shining forth, she looks forth by every one who winks.

verses.sa:
अविर्वै नाम देवतर्तेनास्ते परीवृता ।
तस्या रूपेणेमे वृक्षा हरिता हरितस्रजः ॥
verses.rom:
avirvai nama devatartenaste parivrita |
tasya rupeneme vriksha harita haritasrajah ||
verses.en: The deity, Avi by name, sits enveloped with right; by her form these trees [are] green, green-garlanded.

verses.sa:
अन्ति सन्तं न जहात्यन्ति सन्तं न पश्यति ।
देवस्य पश्य काव्यं न ममार न जीर्यति ॥
verses.rom:
anti santam na jahatyanti santam na pashyati |
devasya pashya kavyam na mamara na jiryati ||
verses.en: Him that is near by he (?) deserts not; him that is near by he (?) sees not; see the wisdom (kā́vya) of the god: he died not, he grows not old.

verses.sa:
अपूर्वेणेषिता वाचस्ता वदन्ति यथायथम् ।
वदन्तीर्यत्र गच्छन्ति तदाहुर्ब्राह्मणं महत् ॥
verses.rom:
apurveneshita vachasta vadanti yathayatham |
vadantiryatra gachchhanti tadahurbrahmanam mahat ||
verses.en: The voices sent forth by the unpreceded one—they speak as they should (yathāyathám); where they go speaking, that [people] call the great brā́hmaṇa n..

verses.sa:
यत्र देवाश्च मनुष्याश्चारा नाभाविव श्रिताः ।
अपां त्वा पुष्पं पृछामि यत्र तन् मायया हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra devashcha manushyashchara nabhaviva shritah |
apam tva pushpam prichhami yatra tan mayaya hitam ||
verses.en: Where both gods and men (manuṣyà) are set (çritá) as spokes in a nave—I ask thee of the flower (púṣpa) of the waters, where that by magic was placed.

verses.sa:
येभिर्वात इषितः प्रवाति ये ददन्ते पञ्च दिशः सध्रीचीः ।
य आहुतिमत्यमन्यन्त देवा अपां नेतारः कतमे त आसन् ॥
verses.rom:
yebhirvata ishitah pravati ye dadante pancha dishah sadhrichih |
ya ahutimatyamanyanta deva apam netarah katame ta asan ||
verses.en: They by whom the wind sent forth blows on, who give the five quarters together (sadhryàñc), the gods who thought themselves above (ati-man) the offering (ā́huti), conductors of the waters—which were they?

verses.sa:
इमामेषां पृथिवीं वस्त एकोऽन्तरिक्षं पर्येको बभूव ।
दिवमेषां ददते यो विधर्ता विश्वा आशाः प्रति रक्षन्त्येके ॥
verses.rom:
imamesham prithivim vasta eko'ntariksham paryeko babhuva |
divamesham dadate yo vidharta vishva ashah prati rakshantyeke ||
verses.en: One of them clothes himself in this earth; one encompassed the atmosphere; he of them who is disposer (vidhartṛ́) gives the sky; some defend respectively all regions (ā́çā).

verses.sa:
यो विद्यात्सूत्रं विततं यस्मिन्न् ओताः प्रजा इमाः ।
सूत्रं सूत्रस्य यो विद्याद्स विद्याद्ब्राह्मणं महत् ॥
verses.rom:
yo vidyatsutram vitatam yasminn otah praja imah |
sutram sutrasya yo vidyadsa vidyadbrahmanam mahat ||
verses.en: Whoso may know the stretched-out string in which these offspring (prajā́) are woven in, whoso may know the string of the string, he may know the great brā́hmaṇa.

verses.sa:
वेदाहं सूत्रं विततं यस्मिन्न् ओताः प्रजा इमाः ।
सूत्रं सूत्रस्याहं वेदाथो यद्ब्राह्मणं महद् ॥
verses.rom:
vedaham sutram vitatam yasminn otah praja imah |
sutram sutrasyaham vedatho yadbrahmanam mahad ||
verses.en: I know the stretched-out string in which these offspring are woven in; the string of the string I know, likewise the great brā́hmaṇa.

verses.sa:
यदन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी अग्निरैत्प्रदहन् विश्वदाव्यः ।
यत्रातिष्ठन्न् एकपत्नीः परस्तात्क्वेवासीन् मातरिश्वा तदानीम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadantara dyavaprithivi agniraitpradahan vishvadavyah |
yatratishthann ekapatnih parastatkvevasin matarishva tadanim ||
verses.en: As between heaven-and-earth Agni went, burning on, all-consuming, where stood beyond they (f.) of one husband—where perchance was Mātariçvan then?

verses.sa:
अप्स्वासीन् मातरिश्वा प्रविष्टः प्रविष्टा देवाः सलिलान्यासन्॥
बृहन् ह तस्थौ रजसो विमानः पवमानो हरित आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
apsvasin matarishva pravishtah pravishta devah salilanyasan||
brihan ha tasthau rajaso vimanah pavamano harita a vivesha ||
verses.en: Mātariçvan was entered into the waters; the gods were entered into the seas; great stood the traverser of space; the purifying one entered into the green ones.

verses.sa:
उत्तरेणेव गयत्रीममृतेऽधि वि चक्रमे ।
साम्ना ये साम संविदुरजस्तद्ददृशे क्व ॥
verses.rom:
uttareneva gayatrimamrite'dhi vi chakrame |
samna ye sama samvidurajastaddadrishe kva ||
verses.en: Higher, as it were, than the gāyatrī́, upon the immortal (amṛ́ta) he strode out; they who know completely chant with chant—where then was seen the goat?

verses.sa:
निवेशनः संगमनो वसूनां देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मा ।
इन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
niveshanah samgamano vasunam deva iva savita satyadharma |
indro na tasthau samare dhananam ||
verses.en: The reposer, the assembler of good things, like god Savitar, of true ordinances (-dhárman), he stood like Indra in the conflict for riches.

verses.sa:
पुण्डरीकं नवद्वारं त्रिभिर्गुणेभिरावृतम् ।
तस्मिन् यद्यक्षमात्मन्वत्तद्वै ब्रह्मविदो विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
pundarikam navadvaram tribhirgunebhiravritam |
tasmin yadyakshamatmanvattadvai brahmavido viduh ||
verses.en: The lotus-flower of nine doors, covered with three strands (guṇá) — what soulful prodigy (yakṣá) is within it, that the bráhman-knowers know.

verses.sa:
अकामो धीरो अमृतः स्वयंभू रसेन तृप्तो न कुतश्चनोनः ।
तमेव विद्वान् न बिभाय मृत्योरात्मानं धीरमजरं युवानम् ॥
verses.rom:
akamo dhiro amritah svayambhu rasena tripto na kutashchanonah |
tameva vidvan na bibhaya mrityoratmanam dhiramajaram yuvanam ||
verses.en: Free from desire, wise (dhī́ra), immortal, self-existent, satisfied with sap, not deficient in any respect—knowing that wise, unaging, young soul, one is not afraid of death.

verses.sa:
अघायतामपि नह्या मुखानि सपत्नेषु वज्रमर्पयैतम् ।
इन्द्रेण दत्ता प्रथमा शतौदना भ्रातृव्यघ्नी यजमानस्य गातुः ॥
verses.rom:
aghayatamapi nahya mukhani sapatneshu vajramarpayaitam |
indrena datta prathama shataudana bhratrivyaghni yajamanasya gatuh ||
verses.en: Fasten thou up the mouths of the mischief-making ones; bring (arpay-) this thunderbolt upon our rivals; given by Indra, first, with a hundred rice-dishes, cousin-slaying, the success (gātú) of the sacrificer.

verses.sa:
वेदिष्टे चर्म भवतु बर्हिर्लोमानि यानि ते ।
एषा त्वा रशनाग्रभीद्ग्रावा त्वैषोऽधि नृत्यतु ॥
verses.rom:
vedishte charma bhavatu barhirlomani yani te |
esha tva rashanagrabhidgrava tvaisho'dhi nrityatu ||
verses.en: Be thy skin the sacrificial hearth, [be] the hairs which [are] thine the barhís; this rein (raçanā́) hath seized thee; let this pressing-stone dance over thee.

verses.sa:
बालास्ते प्रोक्षणीः सन्तु जिह्वा सं मार्ष्टु अघ्न्ये ।
शुद्धा त्वं यज्ञिया भूत्वा दिवं प्रेहि शतौदने ॥
verses.rom:
balaste prokshanih santu jihva sam marshtu aghnye |
shuddha tvam yajniya bhutva divam prehi shataudane ||
verses.en: Be thy tail-tuft the sprinklers; let thy tongue do the cleansing, O inviolable one; do thou, having become clean, fit for sacrifice, go on to heaven, O thou of the hundred rice-dishes.

verses.sa:
यः शतौदनां पचति कामप्रेण स कल्पते ।
प्रीता ह्यस्य ऋत्विजः सर्वे यन्ति यथायथम् ॥
verses.rom:
yah shataudanam pachati kamaprena sa kalpate |
prita hyasya ritvijah sarve yanti yathayatham ||
verses.en: Whoso cooks her of the hundred rice-dishes, he is adapted to the fulfilment of wishes; for all his priests (ṛtvíj), being gratified, go as they should.

verses.sa:
स स्वर्गमा रोहति यत्रादस्त्रिदिवं दिवः ।
अपूपनाभिं कृत्वा यो ददाति शतौदनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa svargama rohati yatradastridivam divah |
apupanabhim kritva yo dadati shataudanam ||
verses.en: He ascends the heavenly road (svargá), where is yon triple heaven of the heaven (dív), who, making [her] cake-naveled, gives her of the hundred rice-dishes.

verses.sa:
स तांल्लोकान्त्समाप्नोति ये दिव्या ये च पार्थिवाः ।
हिरण्यज्योतिषं कृत्वा यो ददाति शतौदनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tamllokantsamapnoti ye divya ye cha parthivah |
hiranyajyotisham kritva yo dadati shataudanam ||
verses.en: He obtains those worlds, [those] which are heavenly and those which are earthly, who, having made [her] lighted with gold, gives her of the hundred rice-dishes.

verses.sa:
ये ते देवि शमितारः पक्तारो ये च ते जनाः ।
ते त्वा सर्वे गोप्स्यन्ति मैभ्यो भैषीः शतौदने ॥
verses.rom:
ye te devi shamitarah paktaro ye cha te janah |
te tva sarve gopsyanti maibhyo bhaishih shataudane ||
verses.en: What people are thy quellers, O heavenly one f., and what thy cookers, they shall all guard thee: be not afraid of them, thou of the hundred rice-dishes.

verses.sa:
वसवस्त्वा दक्षिणत उत्तरान् मरुतस्त्वा ।
आदित्याः पश्चाद्गोप्स्यन्ति साग्निष्टोममति द्रव ॥
verses.rom:
vasavastva dakshinata uttaran marutastva |
adityah pashchadgopsyanti sagnishtomamati drava ||
verses.en: The Vasus shall guard thee on the right, thee the Maruts on the left (uttarā́t), the Ādityas behind; do thou run beyond the Agnishṭoma.

verses.sa:
देवाः पितरो मनुष्या गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च ये ।
ते त्वा सर्वे गोप्स्यन्ति सातिरात्रमति द्रव ॥
verses.rom:
devah pitaro manushya gandharvapsarasashcha ye |
te tva sarve gopsyanti satiratramati drava ||
verses.en: The gods, the Fathers, men (manuṣyà), and they that are Gandharvas-and-Apsarases—they shall all guard thee; do thou run beyond the over-night sacrifice (atirātrá).

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षं दिवं भूमिमादित्यान् मरुतो दिशः ।
लोकान्त्स सर्वान् आप्नोति यो ददाति शतौदनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
antariksham divam bhumimadityan maruto dishah |
lokantsa sarvan apnoti yo dadati shataudanam ||
verses.en: He obtains the atmosphere, the sky, the earth, the Ādityas, the Maruts, the quarters, all worlds, who gives her of the hundred rice-dishes.

verses.sa:
घृतं प्रोक्षन्ती सुभगा देवी देवान् गमिष्यति ।
पक्तारमघ्न्ये मा हिंसीर्दिवं प्रेहि शतौदने ॥
verses.rom:
ghritam prokshanti subhaga devi devan gamishyati |
paktaramaghnye ma himsirdivam prehi shataudane ||
verses.en: Sprinkling forth ghee, well-portioned, the divine one will go to the gods; hurt not him who cooks thee, O inviolable one; go on to heaven, O thou of the hundred rice-dishes.

verses.sa:
ये देवा दिविषदो अन्तरिक्षसदश्च ये ये चेमे भूम्यामधि ।
तेभ्यस्त्वं धुक्ष्व सर्वदा क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
ye deva divishado antarikshasadashcha ye ye cheme bhumyamadhi |
tebhyastvam dhukshva sarvada kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: The gods that are stationed (-sad) in the sky, and that are stationed in the atmosphere, and these that are upon the earth—to them do thou always yield (duh) milk, butter, also honey.

verses.sa:
यत्ते शिरो यत्ते मुखं यौ कर्णौ ये च ते हनू ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte shiro yatte mukham yau karnau ye cha te hanu |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What head is thine, what mouth is thine, what ears and what jaws are thine—let them yield to thy giver curd, milk, butter, also honey.

verses.sa:
यौ त ओष्ठौ ये नासिके ये शृङ्गे ये च तेऽक्षिणी ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yau ta oshthau ye nasike ye shringe ye cha te'kshini |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What lips are thine, what nostrils, what horns, and what thine eyes—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्ते क्लोमा यद्धृदयं पुरीतत्सहकण्ठिका ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte kloma yaddhridayam puritatsahakanthika |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What lungs are thine, what heart, the purītát with the throat—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्ते यकृद्ये मतस्ने यदान्त्रं याश्च ते गुदाः ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte yakridye matasne yadantram yashcha te gudah |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What liver is thine, what two mátasnās, what entrail, and what thine intestines—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यस्ते प्लाशिर्यो वनिष्ठुर्यौ कुक्षी यच्च चर्म ते ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yaste plashiryo vanishthuryau kukshi yachcha charma te |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What plāçí is thine, what rectum (? vaniṣṭhú), what (two) paunches, and what thy skin—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्ते मज्जा यदस्थि यन् मंसं यच्च लोहितम् ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte majja yadasthi yan mamsam yachcha lohitam |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What marrow is thine, what bone, what flesh, and what blood—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यौ ते बाहू ये दोषणी यावंसौ या च ते ककुत्।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yau te bahu ye doshani yavamsau ya cha te kakut|
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What fore-legs (bāhú) are thine, what shanks (doṣán), what shoulders áṅsa, and what thy hump—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यास्ते ग्रीवा ये स्कन्धा याः पृष्टीर्याश्च पर्शवः ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yaste griva ye skandha yah prishtiryashcha parshavah |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What neck-bones (grīvā́) are thine, what shoulder-bones skandhá, what side-bones (pṛṣṭí), and what ribs (párçu)—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यौ त उरू अष्ठीवन्तौ ये श्रोणी या च ते भसत्।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yau ta uru ashthivantau ye shroni ya cha te bhasat|
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What thighs are thine, knee-joints, what hips, and what thy rump—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्ते पुच्छं ये ते बाला यदूधो ये च ते स्तनाः ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte puchchham ye te bala yadudho ye cha te stanah |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What tail is thine, what thy tail-tuft, what udder, and what thy teats—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यास्ते जङ्घाः याः कुष्ठिका ऋच्छरा ये च ते शफाः ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yaste janghah yah kushthika richchhara ye cha te shaphah |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What hind-thighs are thine, what dew-claws, [what] pasterns (ṛchára), and what thy hoofs—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्ते चर्म शतौदने यानि लोमान्यघ्न्ये ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte charma shataudane yani lomanyaghnye |
amiksham duhratam datre kshiram sarpiratho madhu ||
verses.en: What hide is thine, O thou of the hundred rice-dishes, what hairs, O inviolable one—let them yield etc. etc.

verses.sa:
क्रोडौ ते स्तां पुरोडाशावाज्येनाभिघारितौ ।
तौ पक्षौ देवि कृत्वा सा पक्तारं दिवं वह ॥
verses.rom:
krodau te stam purodashavajyenabhigharitau |
tau pakshau devi kritva sa paktaram divam vaha ||
verses.en: Let thy two breasts (kroḍá) be sacrificial cakes, smeared over with sacrificial butter; having made them wings, O divine one, do thou carry him who cooks thee to heaven (dív).

verses.sa:
उलूखले मुसले यश्च चर्मणि यो वा शूर्पे तण्डुलः कणः ।
यं वा वातो मातरिश्वा पवमानो ममाथाग्निष्टद्धोता सुहुतं कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
ulukhale musale yashcha charmani yo va shurpe tandulah kanah |
yam va vato matarishva pavamano mamathagnishtaddhota suhutam krinotu ||
verses.en: What in the mortar, on the pestle, and on the hide, or what rice-grain, [what] kernel in the winnowing-basket, or what the wind, Mātariçvan, blowing (pū), shook (math)—let Agni as hótar make that well-offered.

verses.sa:
अपो देवीर्मधुमतीर्घृतश्चुतो ब्रह्मणां हस्तेषु प्रपृथक्सादयामि ।
यत्काम इदमभिषिञ्चामि वोऽहं तन् मे सर्वं सं पद्यतां वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
apo devirmadhumatirghritashchuto brahmanam hasteshu praprithaksadayami |
yatkama idamabhishinchami vo'ham tan me sarvam sam padyatam vayam syama patayo rayinam ||
verses.en: The heavenly waters, rich in honey, dripping with ghee, I seat in separate succession in the hands of the priests (brahmán); with what desire I now pour you on, let all that fall to my lot; may we be lords of wealth.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते जायमानायै जाताया उत ते नमः ।
बालेभ्यः शफेभ्यो रूपायाघ्न्ये ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste jayamanayai jataya uta te namah |
balebhyah shaphebhyo rupayaghnye te namah ||
verses.en: Homage to thee while being born, homage also to thee when born; to thy tail-tuft, hoofs, form, O inviolable one, be homage.

verses.sa:
यो विद्यात्सप्त प्रवतः सप्त विद्यात्परावतः ।
शिरो यज्ञस्य यो विद्यात्स वशां प्रति गृह्णीयात् ॥
verses.rom:
yo vidyatsapta pravatah sapta vidyatparavatah |
shiro yajnasya yo vidyatsa vasham prati grihniyat ||
verses.en: Whoso may know the seven advances (? pravát), [and] may know the seven distances, whoso may know the head of the sacrifice—he may accept the cow (vaçā́).

verses.sa:
वेदाहं सप्त प्रवतः सप्त वेद परावतः ।
शिरो यज्ञस्याहं वेद सोमं चास्यां विचक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
vedaham sapta pravatah sapta veda paravatah |
shiro yajnasyaham veda somam chasyam vichakshanam ||
verses.en: I know the seven advances, I know the seven distances; I know the head of the sacrifice, and the outlooking soma in her.

verses.sa:
यया द्यौर्यया पृथिवी ययापो गुपिता इमाः ।
वशां सहस्रधारां ब्रह्मणाच्छावदामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yaya dyauryaya prithivi yayapo gupita imah |
vasham sahasradharam brahmanachchhavadamasi ||
verses.en: By whom the sky, by whom the earth, by whom these waters are guarded—the cow, of a thousand streams (-dhā́rā), we address with worship (bráhman).

verses.sa:
शतं कंसाः शतं दोग्धारः शतं गोप्तारो अधि पृष्ठे अस्याः ।
ये देवास्तस्यां प्राणन्ति ते वशां विदुरेकधा ॥
verses.rom:
shatam kamsah shatam dogdharah shatam goptaro adhi prishthe asyah |
ye devastasyam prananti te vasham vidurekadha ||
verses.en: A hundred metal dishes (kaṅsá), a hundred milkers, a hundred guardians, upon the back of her; the gods that breathe in her, they know the cow singly.

verses.sa:
यज्ञपदीराक्षीरा स्वधाप्राणा महीलुका ।
वशा पर्जन्यपत्नी देवाँ अप्येति ब्रह्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
yajnapadirakshira svadhaprana mahiluka |
vasha parjanyapatni devan apyeti brahmana ||
verses.en: Having the sacrifice for feet, cheer (írā-) for milk, svadhā́ for breath, being mahī́lukā, the cow, having Parjanya for spouse, goes unto the gods with worship (bráhman).

verses.sa:
अनु त्वाग्निः प्राविशदनु सोमो वशे त्वा ।
ऊधस्ते भद्रे पर्जन्यो विद्युतस्ते स्तना वशे ॥
verses.rom:
anu tvagnih pravishadanu somo vashe tva |
udhaste bhadre parjanyo vidyutaste stana vashe ||
verses.en: After thee entered Agni, after thee Soma, O cow; thine udder, O excellent one, is Parjanya; the lightnings are thy teats, O cow.

verses.sa:
अपस्त्वं धुक्षे प्रथमा उर्वरा अपरा वशे ।
तृतीयं राष्ट्रं धुक्षेऽन्नं क्षीरं वशे त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
apastvam dhukshe prathama urvara apara vashe |
tritiyam rashtram dhukshe'nnam kshiram vashe tvam ||
verses.en: The waters thou yieldest (duh) first, the cultivated fields after, O cow; thou yieldest kingdom third, food, milk, O cow.

verses.sa:
यदादित्यैर्हूयमानोपातिष्ठ ऋतवरि ।
इन्द्रः सहस्रं पात्रान्त्सोमं त्वापाययद्वशे ॥
verses.rom:
yadadityairhuyamanopatishtha ritavari |
indrah sahasram patrantsomam tvapayayadvashe ||
verses.en: When, called by the Ādityas, thou didst approach, O righteous one, Indra made thee drink a thousand vessels (pā́tra) of soma, O cow.

verses.sa:
यदनूचीन्द्रमैरात्त्वा ऋषभोऽह्वयत्।
तस्मात्ते वृत्रहा पयः क्षीरं क्रुद्धोऽहरद्वशे ॥
verses.rom:
yadanuchindramairattva rishabho'hvayat|
tasmatte vritraha payah kshiram kruddho'haradvashe ||
verses.en: When thou didst go following (anváñc) Indra, then the bull called thee; therefore the Vṛitra-slayer, angry, took thy milk (páyas), milk (kṣīrá), O cow.

verses.sa:
यत्ते क्रुद्धो धनपतिरा क्षीरमहरद्वशे ।
इदं तदद्य नाकस्त्रिषु पात्रेषु रक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
yatte kruddho dhanapatira kshiramaharadvashe |
idam tadadya nakastrishu patreshu rakshati ||
verses.en: When the lord of riches, angry, took thy milk, O cow, then this the firmament (nā́ka) now keeps (rakṣ) in three vessels.

verses.sa:
त्रिषु पात्रेषु तं सोममा देव्यहरद्वशा ।
अथर्वा यत्र दीक्षितो बर्हिष्यास्त हिरण्यये ॥
verses.rom:
trishu patreshu tam somama devyaharadvasha |
atharva yatra dikshito barhishyasta hiranyaye ||
verses.en: In three vessels the heavenly cow took that soma, where Atharvan, consecrated, sat on a golden barhís.

verses.sa:
सं हि सोमेनागत समु सर्वेण पद्वता ।
वशा समुद्रमध्यष्ठद्गन्धर्वैः कलिभिः सह ॥
verses.rom:
sam hi somenagata samu sarvena padvata |
vasha samudramadhyashthadgandharvaih kalibhih saha ||
verses.en: Since she has united (sam-gam) with soma, and with all that has feet, the cow has stood upon the ocean, together with the Gandharvas, the kalís.

verses.sa:
सं हि वातेनागत समु सर्वैः पतत्रिभिः ।
वशा समुद्रे प्रानृत्यदृचः सामानि बिभ्रती ॥
verses.rom:
sam hi vatenagata samu sarvaih patatribhih |
vasha samudre pranrityadrichah samani bibhrati ||
verses.en: Since she has united with the wind, and with all winged ones, the cow danced forth in the ocean, bearing the verses, the chants.

verses.sa:
सं हि सूर्येणागत समु सर्वेण चक्षुषा ।
वशा समुद्रमत्यख्यद्भद्रा ज्योतींषि बिभ्रती ॥
verses.rom:
sam hi suryenagata samu sarvena chakshusha |
vasha samudramatyakhyadbhadra jyotimshi bibhrati ||
verses.en: Since she has united with the sun, and with all sight, the cow has overlooked the ocean, bearing excellent lights.

verses.sa:
अभीवृता हिरण्येन यदतिष्ठ ऋतावरि ।
अश्वः समुद्रो भूत्वाध्यस्कन्दद्वशे त्वा ॥
verses.rom:
abhivrita hiranyena yadatishtha ritavari |
ashvah samudro bhutvadhyaskandadvashe tva ||
verses.en: As, O righteous one, thou didst stand decked (abhi-vṛ) with gold, the ocean, having become a horse, mounted (adhi-skand) thee, O cow.

verses.sa:
तद्भद्राः समगच्छन्त वशा देष्ट्र्यथो स्वधा ।
अथर्वा यत्र दीक्षितो बर्हिष्यास्त हिरण्यये ॥
verses.rom:
tadbhadrah samagachchhanta vasha deshtryatho svadha |
atharva yatra dikshito barhishyasta hiranyaye ||
verses.en: There the excellent ones united, the cow, the directress, also the svadhā́, where Atharvan, consecrated, sat on a golden barhís.

verses.sa:
वशा माता राजन्यस्य वशा माता स्वधे तव ।
वशाया यज्ञ आयुधं ततश्चित्तमजायत ॥
verses.rom:
vasha mata rajanyasya vasha mata svadhe tava |
vashaya yajna ayudham tatashchittamajayata ||
verses.en: The cow is mother of the noble (rājanyà), the cow thy mother, O svadhā́; from the cow was born the weapon; from it was born intent (cittá).

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो बिन्दुरुदचरद्ब्रह्मणः ककुदादधि ।
ततस्त्वं जज्ञिषे वशे ततो होताजायत ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo bindurudacharadbrahmanah kakudadadhi |
tatastvam jajnishe vashe tato hotajayata ||
verses.en: The globule (bindú) went (car) up aloft, out of the summit (kákuda) of the bráhman; thence wast thou born, O cow; thence was the invoker born.

verses.sa:
आस्नस्ते गाथा अभवन्न् उष्णिहाभ्यो बलं वशे ।
पाजस्याज्जज्ञे यज्ञ स्तनेभ्यो रश्मयस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
asnaste gatha abhavann ushnihabhyo balam vashe |
pajasyajjajne yajna stanebhyo rashmayastava ||
verses.en: From thy mouth came (bhū) the songs (gā́thā), from thy nape-bones, O cow, [came] force; from thy belly (? pājasyà) was born the sacrifice, from thy teats the rays.

verses.sa:
ईर्माभ्यामयनं जातं सक्थिभ्यां च वशे तव ।
आन्त्रेभ्यो जज्ञिरे अत्रा उदरादधि वीरुधः ॥
verses.rom:
irmabhyamayanam jatam sakthibhyam cha vashe tava |
antrebhyo jajnire atra udaradadhi virudhah ||
verses.en: From thy (two) fore-legs (īrmá) motion (áyana) was born, and from thy thighs (sákthi), O cow; from thine entrails were born eaters (attrá), out from thy belly (udára) the plants.

verses.sa:
यदुदरं वरुणस्यानुप्राविशथा वशे ।
ततस्त्वा ब्रह्मोदह्वयत्स हि नेत्रमवेत्तव ॥
verses.rom:
yadudaram varunasyanupravishatha vashe |
tatastva brahmodahvayatsa hi netramavettava ||
verses.en: When (yát), O cow, thou didst enter along the belly of Varuṇa, thence the priest (brahmán) called thee up; for he knew thy guidance (netrá).

verses.sa:
सर्वे गर्भादवेपन्त जायमानादसूस्वः ।
ससूव हि तामाहु वशेति ब्रह्मभिः कॢप्तः स ह्यस्या बन्धुः ॥
verses.rom:
sarve garbhadavepanta jayamanadasusvah |
sasuva hi tamahu vasheti brahmabhih kliptah sa hyasya bandhuh ||
verses.en: All trembled at the embryo, while being born, of her who gives not birth (? asūsū́); for "the cow hath given birth," they say of her; shaped (m.) by charms (bráhman); for it is her connection.

verses.sa:
युध एकः सं सृजति यो अस्या एक इद्वशी ।
तरांसि यज्ञा अभवन् तरसां चक्षुरभवद्वशा ॥
verses.rom:
yudha ekah sam srijati yo asya eka idvashi |
taramsi yajna abhavan tarasam chakshurabhavadvasha ||
verses.en: One combines (sam-sṛj) the fighters who alone is in control (vaçín) of her; the sacrifices became energies (? táras); the cow became the eye of energies.

verses.sa:
वशा यज्ञं प्रत्यगृह्णाद्वशा सूर्यमधारयत्।
वशायामन्तरविशदोदनो ब्रह्मणा सह ॥
verses.rom:
vasha yajnam pratyagrihnadvasha suryamadharayat|
vashayamantaravishadodano brahmana saha ||
verses.en: The cow accepted the sacrifice; the cow sustained the sun; within the cow entered the rice-dish together with the priest (brahmán).

verses.sa:
वशामेवामृतमाहुर्वशां मृत्युमुपासते ।
वशेदं सर्वमभवद्देवा मनुष्या असुराः पितर ऋषयः ॥
verses.rom:
vashamevamritamahurvasham mrityumupasate |
vashedam sarvamabhavaddeva manushya asurah pitara rishayah ||
verses.en: The cow they call immortality (amṛ́ta); the cow they worship (upa-ās) as death; the cow became this all—gods, men, Asuras, Fathers, seers.

verses.sa:
य एवं विद्यात्स वशां प्रति गृह्णीयात्।
तथा हि यज्ञः सर्वपाद्दुहे दात्रेऽनपस्फुरन् ॥
verses.rom:
ya evam vidyatsa vasham prati grihniyat|
tatha hi yajnah sarvapadduhe datre'napasphuran ||
verses.en: Whoso knoweth thus, he may accept the cow; for so doth the all-footed sacrifice yield milk (duh) to the giver, unresisting.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो जिह्वा वरुणस्यान्तर्दीद्यत्यासनि ।
तासां या मध्ये राजति सा वशा दुष्प्रतिग्रहा ॥
verses.rom:
tisro jihva varunasyantardidyatyasani |
tasam ya madhye rajati sa vasha dushpratigraha ||
verses.en: Three tongues glisten (dīdī) within the mouth of Varuṇa; of these, the one that shines (rāj) in the middle is the cow, hard of acceptance.

verses.sa:
चतुर्धा रेतो अभवद्वशायाः ।
आपस्तुरीयममृतं तुरीयं यज्ञस्तुरीयं पशवस्तुरीयम् ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdha reto abhavadvashayah |
apasturiyamamritam turiyam yajnasturiyam pashavasturiyam ||
verses.en: The seed of the cow was quartered: the waters a quarter, the amṛ́ta a quarter, the sacrifice a quarter, the domestic animals a quarter.

verses.sa:
वशा द्यौर्वशा पृथिवी वशा विष्णुः प्रजापतिः ।
वशाया दुग्धमपिबन्त्साध्या वसवश्च ये ॥
verses.rom:
vasha dyaurvasha prithivi vasha vishnuh prajapatih |
vashaya dugdhamapibantsadhya vasavashcha ye ||
verses.en: The cow [is] the sky, the cow the earth, the cow Vishṇu, Prajāpati; the yield (dugdhá) of the cow did the Perfectibles (sādhyá) and they who are Vasus drink.

verses.sa:
वशाया दुग्धं पीत्वा साध्या वसवश्च ये ।
ते वै ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपि पयो अस्या उपासते ॥
verses.rom:
vashaya dugdham pitva sadhya vasavashcha ye |
te vai bradhnasya vishtapi payo asya upasate ||
verses.en: Having drunk the yield of the cow, the Perfectibles and they who are Vasus—they verily worship the milk (páyas) of her at the summit of the ruddy one.

verses.sa:
सोममेनामेके दुह्रे घृतमेक उपासते ।
य एवं विदुषे वशां ददुस्ते गतास्त्रिदिवं दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
somamenameke duhre ghritameka upasate |
ya evam vidushe vasham daduste gatastridivam divah ||
verses.en: Some milk her for soma; some worship ghee; they who gave the cow to the one knowing thus are gone to the triple heaven of the heaven.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो वशां दत्त्वा सर्वांल्लोकान्त्समश्नुते ।
ऋतं ह्यस्यामार्पितमपि ब्रह्माथो तपः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanebhyo vasham dattva sarvamllokantsamashnute |
ritam hyasyamarpitamapi brahmatho tapah ||
verses.en: Having given the cow to the Brahmans, one attains all worlds; for righteousness is set in her, also bráhman, likewise penance.

verses.sa:
वशां देवा उप जीवन्ति वशां मनुष्या उत ।
वशेदं सर्वमभवद्यावत्सूर्यो विपश्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vasham deva upa jivanti vasham manushya uta |
vashedam sarvamabhavadyavatsuryo vipashyati ||
verses.en: On the cow the gods subsist; on the cow, men also; the cow became this all, so far as the sun looks abroad.
